jobinrwanda.title: Product Operations Lead (Fixed-Term)
jobinrwanda.description:
About One Acre Fund

Founded in 2006, One Acre Fund equips 5.5 million smallholder farmers to make their farms more productive. Across nine countries that together are home to two-thirds of Africa's farmers, we provide high-quality farm supplies, tree seedlings, accessible credit, modern agronomic training, and a wide range of other agricultural services. On average, this model enables any farmer to increase their income and assets on supported land by more than 35 percent, while permanently improving their resilience. This is all made possible by our team of 9,000+ full-time staff, drawn from diverse backgrounds and professions. To learn more, please see our Why Work Here blog post.

About the Role

You will own the way the Product team works, including discovering and driving efficiencies through AI adoption, administering the product toolkit, process design and adoption, and use of data. If our ways of working aren't maximizing Product value add, it is up to you to fix it.

Responsibilities

Tooling & Infrastructure Administration (40%)

Stack Ownership: Act as the primary administrator for the Product Department’s software stack (e.g., Dragonboat, Figma, Matomo, Notion). Manage configurations, user permissions, licenses, and vendor relationships.

 AI Adoption: Drive smart adoption of AI tools/agents to improve Product’s confidence in the value add of new features and to automate workflows.

 Workflow Configuration: Build and maintain standardized approaches to roadmaps, workflows, and automations to ensure all Domain teams (Field, HQ, CorpTech) operate with consistent visibility.

 Troubleshooting: Serve as the first line of support for PMs facing technical blockers with internal tools.

Data Governance & SROI Tracking (30%)

Troubleshooting: Serve as the first line of support for PMs facing technical blockers with internal tools.

 Impact measurement: Work with PMs to refine their product metrics to ensure they’re strategically aligned, automated, and accurate.

 Data Integrity: Audit analytics tools (e.g., Matomo) to ensure new features are launched with correct event tracking. Flag data quality issues to Engineering.

 Reporting: Own comprehensive reporting, surfacing critical insights on Product impact (e.g., BVMs) and processes (e.g., Roadmap Hygiene) to track progress against targets.

Process Enablement & Logistics (30%)

KPI Tracking: Assist the Dir. of Product with capturing and sharing Product team KPIs, working with Product Managers to ensure accuracy and help drive overall team performance towards targets

 Onboarding: Lead the technical onboarding for new Product hires, ensuring they are trained on our specific templates, tool stack, and "Way of Working."

 Knowledge Management: Maintain the department's internal documentation library (Wiki/Drive) to ensure the "Standard" defined by the Principal is accessible and up-to-date.

Career Growth and Development

We have a strong culture of constant learning and we invest in developing our people. You’ll have weekly check-ins with your manager, access to mentorship and training programs, and regular feedback on your performance. We hold career reviews every six months, and set aside time to discuss your aspirations and career goals. You’ll have the opportunity to shape a growing organization and build a rewarding long-term career.

Qualifications

Across all roles, these are the general qualifications we look for. For this role specifically, you will have:

Soft Skills

Service Mindset: Finds satisfaction in "unblocking" others and building the stage for other PMs to shine.

 Hyper-Organized: Loves checklists, documentation, and bringing order to chaos.

 Influence without Authority: Can drive adoption and compliance with Senior PMs without being their direct manager.

Hard Skills

Tool Administration: Advanced proficiency in configuring PDLC tools (Dragonboat) and documentation platforms (Notion/Confluence).

 Data Fluency: Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills (Pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, cross-sheet formulas) for SROI modeling. Familiarity with web analytics (Matomo/GA).

Knowledge

Product Lifecycle: Understanding of how software is built (Agile/Scrum basics) to effectively support the PM workflow.

Preferred Start Date

As soon as possible

Job Location

Nairobi, Kenya or Kigali, Rwanda

Benefits

Health insurance, housing, and comprehensive benefits

Contract Duration

Founded in 2006, One Acre Fund equips 5.5 million smallholder farmers to make their farms more productive. About the Role

You will own the way the Product team works, including discovering and driving efficiencies through AI adoption, administering the product toolkit, process design and adoption, and use of data. If our ways of working aren't maximizing Product value add, it is up to you to fix it.

Responsibilities

Tooling & Infrastructure Administration (40%)

Stack Ownership: Act as the primary administrator for the Product Department’s software stack (e.g., Dragonboat, Figma, Matomo, Notion). Manage configurations, user permissions, licenses, and vendor relationships.

 AI Adoption: Drive smart adoption of AI tools/agents to improve Product’s confidence in the value add of new features and to automate workflows.

 Workflow Configuration: Build and maintain standardized approaches to roadmaps, workflows, and automations to ensure all Domain teams (Field, HQ, CorpTech) operate with consistent visibility.

 Troubleshooting: Serve as the first line of support for PMs facing technical blockers with internal tools.

Data Governance & SROI Tracking (30%)

Troubleshooting: Serve as the first line of support for PMs facing technical blockers with internal tools.

 Impact measurement: Work with PMs to refine their product metrics to ensure they’re strategically aligned, automated, and accurate.

 Data Integrity: Audit analytics tools (e.g., Matomo) to ensure new features are launched with correct event tracking. Flag data quality issues to Engineering.

 Reporting: Own comprehensive reporting, surfacing critical insights on Product impact (e.g., BVMs) and processes (e.g., Roadmap Hygiene) to track progress against targets.

Process Enablement & Logistics (30%)

KPI Tracking: Assist the Dir. of Product with capturing and sharing Product team KPIs, working with Product Managers to ensure accuracy and help drive overall team performance towards targets

 Onboarding: Lead the technical onboarding for new Product hires, ensuring they are trained on our specific templates, tool stack, and "Way of Working."

 Knowledge Management: Maintain the department's internal documentation library (Wiki/Drive) to ensure the "Standard" defined by the Principal is accessible and up-to-date.

Career Growth and Development

We have a strong culture of constant learning and we invest in developing our people. You’ll have weekly check-ins with your manager, access to mentorship and training programs, and regular feedback on your performance. We hold career reviews every six months, and set aside time to discuss your aspirations and career goals. You’ll have the opportunity to shape a growing organization and build a rewarding long-term career.

Qualifications

Across all roles, these are the general qualifications we look for. For this role specifically, you will have:

Soft Skills

Service Mindset: Finds satisfaction in "unblocking" others and building the stage for other PMs to shine.

 Hyper-Organized: Loves checklists, documentation, and bringing order to chaos.

 Influence without Authority: Can drive adoption and compliance with Senior PMs without being their direct manager.

Hard Skills

Tool Administration: Advanced proficiency in configuring PDLC tools (Dragonboat) and documentation platforms (Notion/Confluence).

 Data Fluency: Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills (Pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, cross-sheet formulas) for SROI modeling. Familiarity with web analytics (Matomo/GA).

Knowledge

Product Lifecycle: Understanding of how software is built (Agile/Scrum basics) to effectively support the PM workflow.

Preferred Start Date

As soon as possible

Job Location

Nairobi, Kenya or Kigali, Rwanda

Benefits

Health insurance, housing, and comprehensive benefits

Contract Duration

2 Years

Eligibility

This role is only open to citizens or permanent residents of Kenya, Rwanda, Burundi, Malawi, Zambia, Democratic Republic of Congo, Tanzania, Uganda Ethiopia and Nigeria.

03 November 2026. Please note that we hire on a rolling basis which means that applications are reviewed and processed on a continuous basis until a hire is made.

jobinrwanda.description:
About One Acre Fund

Founded in 2006, One Acre Fund equips 5.5 million smallholder farmers to make their farms more productive. Across nine countries that together are home to two-thirds of Africa's farmers, we provide high-quality farm supplies, tree seedlings, accessible credit, modern agronomic training, and a wide range of other agricultural services. On average, this model enables any farmer to increase their income and assets on supported land by more than 35 percent, while permanently improving their resilience. This is all made possible by our team of 9,000+ full-time staff, drawn from diverse backgrounds and professions. To learn more, please see our Why Work Here blog post.

About the Role

By 2030, our organisation will serve 10 million farm families annually. This growth will be fuelled by fundraising, and at One Acre Fund, our fundraising relies on industry-leading grant and partnership management. We have a 10-person grant management team within our larger Business Development department, responsible for stewarding our highest-value donor partnerships, and are now looking for new Strategic Partnerships Senior Associates / Managers to join this team.

These roles will manage some of our highest-value donor partnerships, leading the coordination and monitoring of grant-funded activities. All roles will report to leaders within our Global Business Development team, while closely coordinating with leaders for the relevant programs. All roles will also interact closely across 1AF’s programming, building deep fluency with our approach to smallholder agriculture: equipping farmers with high-quality products/services to increase their harvests and profits, build their climate resilience, and improve their long-term livelihoods.

Specific roles will have major emphasis areas based on the nature of each donor partnership, helping the organisation pioneer new approaches to thematic priorities including conservation agriculture, engaging women and youth farmers, and smallholder insurance.

Responsibilities

Drive thematic partnerships happening in the field: You will bring an ambitious vision of smallholder prosperity to life in new thematic areas for the organisation, helping us build the capacity to deliver impact to smallholders through conservation agriculture, women/youth engagement, and/or smallholder insurance:

Project Management and Coordination: Partner with program teams to set goals, design and run project activities, anticipate challenges, and keep every part of the plan moving forward smoothly.

 Collaborative Problem Solving: Work closely with program staff to tackle day-to-day and long-term challenges, bringing real-world insights directly to org leadership and the donor.

 Program Fluency: Spend dedicated time in the field with farmers and staff to fully understand work and ensure that all we do in the partnership remains tailored to what farmers really need.

Own, manage and/or support key donor relationships: You will ensure One Acre Fund builds and maintains an excellent relationship with our partners, translating field impact into clear, compelling narratives and keeping our partners deeply connected to our progress:

Donor Engagement: Act as the main point of contact for all funder communications, seamlessly bridging the gap between donors and field teams in whatever ways are needed, including regular communications, coordinating visits, and more as required.

 Storytelling and Reporting: Through deep program fluency, deliver clear, high-quality narrative and financial updates that demonstrate to our partners the true impact of their support.

 Grant Administration: Manage the essential day-to-day details of the funding, including accurate data tracking, invoices, and otherwise ensuring all grant operations are running smoothly and on time.

Career Growth and Development

We have a strong culture of constant learning and we invest in developing our people. You’ll have weekly check-ins with your manager, access to mentorship and training programs, and regular feedback on your performance. We hold career reviews every six months, and set aside time to discuss your aspirations and career goals. You’ll have the opportunity to shape a growing organization and build a rewarding long-term career.

Qualifications

Across all roles, these are the general qualifications we look for. For this role specifically, you will have:

Bachelor's degree in International Development, Public Policy, Business, Economics, or a related field.

 5-10 years of professional experience in international development, strategic partnerships, grant management, consulting, or project management, depending on role level.

 Experience in a public-facing role and with managing external stakeholders, preferred.

 Strong writing and communication skills.

 Excellent organisational skills with a willingness to take initiative and be proactive.

 Proven negotiation and problem-solving skills.

 Comfortable with data and working in Google Sheets, preferred.

 Fluency in English required.

Preferred Start Date

As soon as possible

Job Location

Kigali, Rwanda, Nairobi, Kenya or the United States (Must be on the East Coast, with a strong preference for New York City).

After you apply, we will notify you which opening/s you are being considered for based on your experience and existing work eligibility for each location as follows:

Kigali, Rwanda: One Acre Fund can support a work permit for this role. However, nationals of (or those with an extensive professional background and work history in) our countries of operation are preferred.

 Nairobi, Kenya: Open to citizens or permanent residents of Kenya.

 US: Open to citizens or permanent residents of the U.S.

Benefits

Health insurance, housing, and comprehensive benefits.

Contract Duration

2 years, renewable with a high chance based on good performance.

Travel Requirement

At least two weeks per year. Candidates based in the US should expect to spend four weeks visiting our programs in their first year, with a minimum of two weeks annual travel expected thereafter.

Eligibility

This role is open to all applicants; however, candidates with citizenship or permanent residency in Kenya, Rwanda, Uganda, Tanzania, or Burundi are strongly preferred.

Application Deadline

23 October 2026. Please note that we hire on a rolling basis which means that applications are reviewed and processed on a continuous basis until a hire is made.

One Acre Fund never asks candidates to pay any money or pay for tests at any stage of the interview process. Official One Acre Fund emails will always arrive from an @oneacrefund.org address. Please report any suspicious communication here (globalhotline@oneacrefund.org), but do not send applications or application materials to this email address.

Seeking an exceptional climate finance professional with 5+ years of experience to drive financial modelling and fundraising for our agroforestry carbon pilots, preferably based in Nairobi or Kigali.

You will help develop cutting-edge carbon projects that will unlock impact for smallholder farmers while developing a deep expertise in blended finance strategies.

You will report to the Carbon Finance Senior Manager.

Responsibilities

Essential function #1: Drive Financial Modelling and Analysis (40%)

Build, maintain, and stress-test complex financial models (3-statement financial models across an SPV and local project entities) for agroforestry carbon projects to assess project economics, cash flow needs, and return on investment. This includes maintaining internal models while producing external versions to guide negotiations with carbon buyers and investors.

 Analyze sensitivity scenarios to inform pricing strategies and risk management for carbon credit generation.

 Provide support to the structural design and setup of a new carbon finance SPV lead on components of structural design, setup, and administration. The SPV is a dedicated separate vehicle dedicated to securing pre-finance for PES pilot projects.

Essential function #2: Support External Fundraising and Partnerships (30%)

Support behind-the-scenes on external fundraising and partnership efforts with existing or new carbon funders, ensuring timely reporting and continued alignment with project goals.

 Manage centralized dashboards and reporting systems (using tools like Sales Force) to monitor fundraising pipelines.

 Identify and cultivate new prospects, including impact investors and carbon credit buyers, to expand the funding pipeline.

 Develop high-quality pitch decks and investment memos that articulate the value proposition of One Acre Fund’s carbon projects.

Essential function #3: Coordinate Internal Stakeholders and Strategy for Carbon Finance (30%)

Interface with country program and core function teams (finance, legal, impact, etc) to ensure alignment between budgets and fundraising models for carbon projects.

 Liaise with grant fundraising teams to develop a pipeline of philanthropic prospects to support carbon project costs that align with project requirements

 Prepare materials for leadership calls to update senior stakeholders on fundraising progress and financial health of the carbon projects.

 Collaborate with the legal and compliance teams to review term sheets and financing agreements between investors, the SPV and One Acre Fund.

 Support the carbon finance senior manager in administrative elements of developing the carbon fund SPV.

Career Growth and Development

We have a strong culture of constant learning and we invest in developing our people. You’ll have weekly check-ins with your manager, access to mentorship and training programs, and regular feedback on your performance. You’ll have the opportunity to shape a growing organization and build a rewarding long-term career.

Qualifications

Across all roles, these are the general qualifications we look for. For this role specifically, you will have:

5+ years of professional experience with 3+ years in climate finance, project finance, accounting, or a related field.

 1+ years of professional experience in one of our countries of operation (particular focus on Kenya, Rwanda, Zambia, Malawi, and Tanzania).

 Demonstrated experience in the Voluntary Carbon Market (VCM) or familiarity with carbon project development or similar project finance lifecycles.

 Experience supporting fundraising rounds or managing relationships with institutional donors and investors.

 Advanced proficiency in financial modelling (Excel but predominantly in Google Sheets), with a proven ability to build dynamic models from scratch for project finance or structured finance across multiple regulatory jurisdictions.

As soon as possible

Job Location

Nairobi, Kenya, or Kigali, Rwanda.

Benefits

Health insurance, housing, and comprehensive benefits

Eligibility

Step Up as a Deputy Leader:

Act as the strategic deputy to the Payments & Treasury leadership team. You’ll serve as a thought partner, lead high-stakes cross-functional projects, and ensure seamless continuity of our operations.

Career Growth and Development

Qualifications

The Certification: You are a certified CPA or ACCA Finalist (this is a mandatory requirement).

 The Credentials: A Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related field.

 The Experience: At least 6 to 8 years of progressive experience in finance operations, treasury, payments, or financial controls.

 The Technical Edge: Deep expertise in bank, vendor, and balance sheet reconciliations, alongside advanced hands-on experience with modern ERP systems.

 The Spreadsheet Power User: Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills (you know how to manipulate data and build reports that tell a story).

As soon as possible

jobinrwanda.description:
About One Acre Fund

Founded in 2006, One Acre Fund equips 5.5 million smallholder farmers to make their farms more productive. Across nine countries that together are home to two-thirds of Africa's farmers, we provide high-quality farm supplies, tree seedlings, accessible credit, modern agronomic training, and a wide range of other agricultural services. On average, this model enables any farmer to increase their income and assets on supported land by more than 35 percent, while permanently improving their resilience. This is all made possible by our team of 9,000+ full-time staff, drawn from diverse backgrounds and professions. To learn more, please see our Why Work Here blog post.

Our Rwanda program, founded in 2007, is our largest and operates under the local brand Tubura. We have more than 3,000 staff across all four provinces of Rwanda, as well as in Kigali. Together, we served more than 2.8 million farmers in 2024. We work closely with the government to support national efforts to improve food security. Additionally, we help channel funding and resources to promising agri-SMEs, supporting farmers by providing a market for high-impact crops such as coffee, avocado, and chili.

About the Role

Looking for a Seed Inspection and Sampling Senior Supervisor experienced in Seed inspection, field and storage sampling and phytosanitary checks to ensure compliant and high-quality seed production.

Responsibilities

Seed inspection

Seed sampling

Authorize or reject seed lots for further testing based on field and storage inspection findings

Sample handling and documentation

Recommend corrective actions and follow up on their implementation with production teams.

Support quality assurance and testing activities

Escalate critical quality issues that may affect seed performance or compliance.

Collaboration with sample-related personnel

Propose and implement improvements in inspection and sampling processes.

 Coordinate directly with field and laboratory teams to ensure quality standards are met.

Career Growth and Development

We have a strong culture of constant learning and we invest in developing our people. You’ll have weekly check-ins with your manager, access to mentorship and training programs, and regular feedback on your performance. We hold career reviews every six months, and set aside time to discuss your aspirations and career goals. You’ll have the opportunity to shape a growing organization and build a rewarding long-term career.

Qualifications

Across all roles, these are the general qualifications we look for. For this role specifically, you will have:

1+ Year of inspection and sampling experience or in a related field

 Strong Stakeholder Management (Collaborate with stakeholders and laboratory staff)

 Basic agronomic aspects on different crop seeds

brightermonday.title: Country Manager, Rwanda
brightermonday.description:
Job summary

 The Country Manager is responsible for building and growing our commercial presence in Rwanda. As the most senior person on the ground, you will own the country revenue target, lead and develop the local sales team, and take care of the light operational and administrative matters needed to run the business day-to-day. You will represent the company to customers, channel partners, telecom operators and regulators, and act as the local face of the organization while working closely with the GM Sales in Kenya and central support functions.

 Min Qualification:

 Bachelors

 Experience Level:

 Senior level

 Experience Length:
 8 years

 Language Requirement:
 English

 Working Hours:

 Full Time - 8 to 5

 Job descriptions & requirements

 Location: Kigali, Rwanda

Reports to General Manager, Sales (based in Nairobi, Kenya)

Reporting line: GM Sales → Managing Director

Direct reports: Rwanda sales team (Account Executives / Sales Representatives / Channel staff)

Function: Sales leadership with light in-country operations

Employment type: Full-time, permanent (local contract)

Role purpose

The Country Manager is responsible for building and growing our commercial presence in Rwanda. As the most senior person on the ground, you will own the country revenue target, lead and develop the local sales team, and take care of the light operational and administrative matters needed to run the business day-to-day. You will represent the company to customers, channel partners, telecom operators and regulators, and act as the local face of the organization while working closely with the GM Sales in Kenya and central support functions.

Key responsibilities

Sales & revenue (primary focus)

• Own the numbers. Deliver the agreed Rwanda sales and revenue targets (new business, expansion and renewals), with accurate forecasting.

• Build and execute the country go-to-market plan across direct sales and channel/partner routes.

• Drive the full sales cycle for strategic accounts: prospecting, qualification, solution selling, negotiation and close.

• Grow recurring revenue (ARR/MRR) by improving retention, reducing churn and expanding existing accounts.

• Maintain a healthy, well-qualified pipeline and keep the CRM (e.g. Salesforce / HubSpot) accurate and up to date.

Team leadership & development

• Recruit, lead, coach and motivate the local sales team; set individual targets and manage performance.

• Instil a disciplined sales methodology, weekly cadence, and a high-performance, accountable culture.

• Develop talent and succession within the team as the market scales.

Light operations & administration

• Run day-to-day country operations: office/logistics, local vendors and suppliers, and general administration.

• Compliance liaison. Work with central finance/HR and local advisors to keep the business compliant with company filings, RSSB contributions, PAYE/tax, work permits and statutory obligations.

• Support local finance operations: assist with invoicing, collections and expense oversight in coordination with the Kenya finance team.

• Data protection. Ensure customer and employee data are handled in line with the Law relating to the protection of personal data and privacy, 2021.

Market, partnerships & stakeholders

• Build and manage relationships with channel partners, resellers, telecom operators and key enterprise customers.

• Regulatory & government relations. Represent the company with relevant authorities, including the Rwanda Utilities Regulatory Authority (RURA), and keep abreast of local regulatory developments.

• Provide market intelligence, competitor activity, pricing, customer needs and opportunities back to the GM Sales and leadership team.

Key performance indicators

• Achievement of Rwanda revenue and new-business targets (quarterly and annual).

• Pipeline coverage and forecast accuracy.

• Net revenue retention / churn.

• Sales team attainment, productivity and retention.

• Timely, compliant country operations (statutory, financial and administrative).

Qualifications & experience

• Bachelor's degree in business, IT, engineering, marketing or a related field; a relevant postgraduate qualification (e.g. MBA) is an advantage.

• 8–12 years' experience in B2B / enterprise sales within technology, telecom or SaaS, including at least 3–5 years leading a sales team.

• Demonstrable track record of consistently meeting or exceeding revenue targets and building teams from an early stage.

• Deep local market knowledge. Strong existing network across enterprise, government and/or channel ecosystems in Rwanda.

• Comfortable operating with autonomy in a lean, fast-moving environment where you also handle operational and administrative matters.

• Solid commercial and basic financial acumen; comfortable with CRM and sales analytics tools.

Skills & competencies

• Excellent consultative selling, negotiation and closing skills.

• Strong leadership presence and the ability to build, coach and inspire a team.

• Sound judgement and integrity; able to represent the company credibly with senior stakeholders and regulators.

• Organised, hands-on and self-directed; able to balance revenue focus with operational responsibilities.

• Strong communication and cross-cultural collaboration skills, working with a regional (Kenya-based) leadership team.

Language requirements

• Fluency in English is required. Proficiency in Kinyarwanda and/or French is a strong advantage and important for customer, partner and government engagement.

What we offer

Competitive base salary plus performance-based commission/bonus, statutory and company benefits, and the opportunity to build and lead a market as we scale across the region.

How to Apply:
All applications will be received and reviewed through the BrighterMonday Portal by clicking on the 'Apply Here' section

Job descriptions & requirements

Location: Kigali, Rwanda
Reports to General Manager, Sales (based in Nairobi, Kenya)
Reporting line: GM Sales → Managing Director
Direct reports: Rwanda sales team (Account Executives / Sales Representatives / Channel staff)
Function: Sales leadership with light in-country operations
Employment type: Full-time, permanent (local contract)
Role purpose
The Country Manager is responsible for building and growing our commercial presence in Rwanda. As the most senior person on the ground, you will own the country revenue target, lead and develop the local sales team, and take care of the light operational and administrative matters needed to run the business day-to-day. You will represent the company to customers, channel partners, telecom operators and regulators, and act as the local face of the organization while working closely with the GM Sales in Kenya and central support functions.
Key responsibilities
Sales & revenue (primary focus)
• Own the numbers. Deliver the agreed Rwanda sales and revenue targets (new business, expansion and renewals), with accurate forecasting.
• Build and execute the country go-to-market plan across direct sales and channel/partner routes.
• Drive the full sales cycle for strategic accounts: prospecting, qualification, solution selling, negotiation and close.
• Grow recurring revenue (ARR/MRR) by improving retention, reducing churn and expanding existing accounts.
• Maintain a healthy, well-qualified pipeline and keep the CRM (e.g. Salesforce / HubSpot) accurate and up to date.
Team leadership & development
• Recruit, lead, coach and motivate the local sales team; set individual targets and manage performance.
• Instil a disciplined sales methodology, weekly cadence, and a high-performance, accountable culture.
• Develop talent and succession within the team as the market scales.
Light operations & administration
• Run day-to-day country operations: office/logistics, local vendors and suppliers, and general administration.
• Compliance liaison. Work with central finance/HR and local advisors to keep the business compliant with company filings, RSSB contributions, PAYE/tax, work permits and statutory obligations.
• Support local finance operations: assist with invoicing, collections and expense oversight in coordination with the Kenya finance team.
• Data protection. Ensure customer and employee data are handled in line with the Law relating to the protection of personal data and privacy, 2021.
Market, partnerships & stakeholders
• Build and manage relationships with channel partners, resellers, telecom operators and key enterprise customers.
• Regulatory & government relations. Represent the company with relevant authorities, including the Rwanda Utilities Regulatory Authority (RURA), and keep abreast of local regulatory developments.
• Provide market intelligence, competitor activity, pricing, customer needs and opportunities back to the GM Sales and leadership team.
Key performance indicators
• Achievement of Rwanda revenue and new-business targets (quarterly and annual).
• Pipeline coverage and forecast accuracy.
• Net revenue retention / churn.
• Sales team attainment, productivity and retention.
• Timely, compliant country operations (statutory, financial and administrative).
Qualifications & experience
• Bachelor's degree in business, IT, engineering, marketing or a related field; a relevant postgraduate qualification (e.g. MBA) is an advantage.
• 8–12 years' experience in B2B / enterprise sales within technology, telecom or SaaS, including at least 3–5 years leading a sales team.
• Demonstrable track record of consistently meeting or exceeding revenue targets and building teams from an early stage.
• Deep local market knowledge. Strong existing network across enterprise, government and/or channel ecosystems in Rwanda.
• Comfortable operating with autonomy in a lean, fast-moving environment where you also handle operational and administrative matters.
• Solid commercial and basic financial acumen; comfortable with CRM and sales analytics tools.
Skills & competencies
• Excellent consultative selling, negotiation and closing skills.
• Strong leadership presence and the ability to build, coach and inspire a team.
• Sound judgement and integrity; able to represent the company credibly with senior stakeholders and regulators.
• Organised, hands-on and self-directed; able to balance revenue focus with operational responsibilities.
• Strong communication and cross-cultural collaboration skills, working with a regional (Kenya-based) leadership team.
Language requirements
• Fluency in English is required. Proficiency in Kinyarwanda and/or French is a strong advantage and important for customer, partner and government engagement.

brightermonday.title: Community Officer – Rwanda
brightermonday.description:
Job summary

 BrighterMonday is East Africa's largest job platform, and we're building our community in Rwanda.
You'll be the voice of it. The person job seekers talk to when they need help. The person employers ask when they're getting started. The person who replies when someone comments on our posts.
We have two communities in Rwanda, and you'll build both. J

 Min Qualification:

 Bachelors

 Experience Level:

 Entry level

 Experience Length:
 2 years

 Language Requirement:
 English, French, Kinyarwanda

 Working Hours:

 Full Time - 8 to 5

 Applicant Location:
 Kigali (capital), Rwanda

 Job descriptions & requirements

 The role

BrighterMonday is East Africa's largest job platform, and we're building our community in Rwanda.

You'll be the voice of it. The person job seekers talk to when they need help. The person employers ask when they're getting started. The person who replies when someone comments on our posts.

We have two communities in Rwanda, and you'll build both. Job seekers looking for work, and employers looking for people. Your job is to make sure that everyone who comes to us finds a real person who is quick, useful and worth coming back to.

What you'll own

Community and communication

You are the front line across calls, email, WhatsApp and social, for both sides of the platform. Job seekers asking how to strengthen an application. Employers asking how to post a role or why they're not getting the candidates they expected. You answer well, you answer fast, and you resolve things at first contact wherever you can.

You'll also run recurring community touchpoints of your own design — a WhatsApp community, a newsletter, a monthly clinic. Your call on the format, and it may look different for employers than for job seekers. What matters is that people come back.

University onboarding

You'll bring Rwandan universities and TVETs onto the platform: setting them up, training their career services teams, and helping their students build profiles and start applying. This is where a lot of your impact will land, and it's the part of the job that gets you out from behind the screen.

Employer engagement

Helping employers get up and running, answering their questions, and getting our materials into their hands. You'll also support our partnership and commercial work in-market — the meetings that need a local presence, the follow-ups, the relationships that need someone nearby to keep them warm.

Events and webinars

Sessions for job seekers and employers, run end to end — scheduling, speakers, logistics, registration, reminders, live support and follow-up. We care about what people do afterwards, not how many logged in.

Records and insight

Every interaction in the CRM, complete and current. Once a month, a short note to us: what's working, what's blocking, what people keep asking for. You'll be closer to the Rwandan market than anyone else in the company, and we'll act on what you tell us.

Whatever the market needs

We're early in Rwanda. Some of what you'll do isn't on this list yet, and you'll be one of the people who works out what it should be.

Working remotely, across four markets

You won't be doing this alone. You'll have regular check-ins with the Group Head of Strategy, and our marketing, CX, product and matching teams sit across our other markets and work with you every week — briefing them, chasing what you need, and telling them the truth about what's happening on the ground. Most people don't get that kind of regional exposure until much later in their careers. You'll get it in your first month.

The role is remote and you'll be our person in Rwanda, so you'll need to be comfortable owning your own week and moving things forward under your own steam.

What you'll need

At least two years of experience, or a recent graduate who has visibly run something — a society, a business, a campaign
Fluent Kinyarwanda and English. French is an advantage
You're good online. You can write a reply that sounds like a person and still represents a company
You can switch register. On the same day you'll write to a second-year student and to an HR manager, and both should feel you were speaking to them
You're organised, you follow through, and you write things down
You know Kigali's universities and where young people actually are
Reliable internet and a working setup at home

What we offer

You'll report directly to our Group Head of Strategy, with real ownership of how our Rwandan community takes shape and direct exposure to how a four-market business is run. This is an unusual amount of scope for an early-career role, and we mean it — you'll be shaping something rather than maintaining it.

brightermonday.title: Communication Analyst, Ippsa8 -office Based
brightermonday.description:
Job descriptions & requirements

Job Description
Background:
UN Women, grounded in the vision of equality enshrined in the Charter of the United Nations, works for the elimination of discrimination against women and girls; the empowerment of women; and the achievement of equality between women and men as partners and beneficiaries of development, human rights, humanitarian action and peace and security.
Placing women’s rights at the center of all its efforts, UN Women leads and coordinates United Nations system efforts to ensure that commitments on gender equality and gender mainstreaming translate into action throughout the world. It provides strong and coherent leadership in support of Member States’ priorities and efforts, building effective partnerships with civil society and other relevant actors.
The UN Women Rwanda Country Office (CO) Strategic Note (2026–2029), aligned with NST II, the UNSDCF 2025–2029, and the UN Women Strategic Plan 2026–2029, advances a country presence centered on upstream policy influence, evidence-based advocacy, catalytic programming, and strengthened UN system coordination to accelerate gender equality and women’s empowerment (GEWE). Leveraging UN Women’s triple mandate, normative, coordination, and operational, the CO plays a central coordination and advocacy role across national development processes and multi-stakeholder partnerships, strengthening inter-agency collaboration, supporting government-led gender integration in policies, plans, and budgets, and advancing strategic engagement with development partners, civil society, the private sector, and academia. The CO also promotes high-level advocacy, visibility, and accountability for GEWE commitments while facilitating knowledge exchange and positioning gender equality as a cross-cutting development priority.
To fully operationalize the Strategic Note, the UN Women Rwanda Country Office will roll out targeted communication initiatives to articulate its new positioning, demonstrate its value addition, and deepen partner engagement. It will capitalize on GEWE campaigns and key moments to foster dialogue and collaboration with diverse stakeholders. In addition, the Office will position itself as a trusted knowledge and learning hub by strengthening knowledge management and strategic storytelling. It will produce and disseminate high-quality, evidence-based knowledge products, including reports, briefs, and advocacy materials, to shape policy discourse, influence decision-making, and elevate visibility of results. The Office will also leverage strategic partnerships and platforms to amplify key messages and scale impact. In parallel, it will actively promote South–South cooperation and cross-country learning, facilitating the exchange and adaptation of promising GEWE practices across contexts. Through these efforts, the Office will enhance its visibility, credibility, and influence as a leader in advancing gender equality and women’s empowerment.
Reporting to the Country Representative, the Communications Analyst is responsible for assisting in the planning and implementation of the office communications and advocacy strategies to increase the standing and awareness of UN Women with partners, the media and the public.
The Communications Analyst also works in close collaboration with the Programme, Operations and technical teams in the Rwanda Country Office, HQ/Regional communications teams, personnel of other UN Agencies, Government officials, media, multilateral and bilateral donors and civil society.
III. Scope of Work

 Provide substantive support to the planning and design of external communication and outreach/advocacy strategies and plans
Provide analysis for elaboration of communication strategies; ensure gender perspective;
Integrate communication, advocacy and outreach strategies into proposals for project/programmes and other initiatives, as necessary;
Monitor and analyze print and social media and provide analysis to RO/HQ;
Provide inputs and support to the launch of in-country UN Women/ UN system corporate and local campaigns and special events.
Support the implementation of UN Women’s corporate campaigns such as HeForShe, Generational Equality and Global Media Compact;
Ensure high visibility of UN Women in key national and international events/campaigns; and
Participate in the UNCG meetings and contribute to the efforts of Communicating as One and mainstreaming gender in the ONE UN Rwanda communications.
Coordinate and contribute substantively to the development and dissemination of advocacy materials in Rwanda Country Office 
Draft briefing materials, and press releases and coordinate its dissemination through effective channels;
Identify storylines for publication and articles;

UN Women, grounded in the vision of equality enshrined in the Charter of the United Nations, works for the elimination of discrimination against women and girls; the empowerment of women; and the achievement of equality between women and men as partners and beneficiaries of development, human rights, humanitarian action and peace and security.
Placing women’s rights at the center of all its efforts, UN Women leads and coordinates United Nations system efforts to ensure that commitments on gender equality and gender mainstreaming translate into action throughout the world. It provides strong and coherent leadership in support of Member States’ priorities and efforts, building effective partnerships with civil society and other relevant actors.
The UN Women Rwanda Country Office (CO) Strategic Note (2026–2029), aligned with NST II, the UNSDCF 2025–2029, and the UN Women Strategic Plan 2026–2029, advances a country presence centered on upstream policy influence, evidence-based advocacy, catalytic programming, and strengthened UN system coordination to accelerate gender equality and women’s empowerment (GEWE). Leveraging UN Women’s triple mandate, normative, coordination, and operational, the CO plays a central coordination and advocacy role across national development processes and multi-stakeholder partnerships, strengthening inter-agency collaboration, supporting government-led gender integration in policies, plans, and budgets, and advancing strategic engagement with development partners, civil society, the private sector, and academia. The CO also promotes high-level advocacy, visibility, and accountability for GEWE commitments while facilitating knowledge exchange and positioning gender equality as a cross-cutting development priority.

The Office will also leverage strategic partnerships and platforms to amplify key messages and scale impact. Through these efforts, the Office will enhance its visibility, credibility, and influence as a leader in advancing gender equality and women’s empowerment.

brightermonday.title: Guest Experience Expert
brightermonday.description:
Job descriptions & requirements

( 20979 )
At One&Only, we exist to create joy for our guests through anticipation, creativity, precision, empathy and warmth. We tailor every aspect of our guests’ stay to bring their dreams and desires to life. With an atmosphere that’s chic but wonderfully unstuffy™, and a team who are meticulous but warm, we seek to exceed our guests’ expectations at every possible turn.
Cushioned in the foothills of the breath-taking Virunga Volcano Range, One&Only Gorilla’s Nest makes the magical possible to enjoy a once-in-a-lifetime, personal encounter with the rare and majestic mountain gorilla, roaming free in its own natural habitat. The warm African charm is one of our most unique and valued assets. With abundant knowledge and generosity, we anticipate our guest’s every need and surpass expectations. Whether we are designing the perfect day out or arranging a romantic private dinner, we approach everything with imagination to spark a sense of playfulness, discovery and adventure. This is not simply our job, it’s our passion. We don’t just exist in the environment, we exist with the environment; from working the land or building a shelter, we like to give back in as many ways as we can to help our communities flourish.
1 Position Details

 Position Guest Experience Expert 
 Level Colleague 
 Department Experience Department 
 Reports to Experience Manager 
 Subordinates None

2 Job Details & Requirements
Job Summary
Organize, arrange and follow through personalised tours and itineraries, field activities and services for the guests of One&Only Gorillas Nest through direct or indirect co-ordination with other departments and external/governmental excursion providers.
Being responsible for accurate and timely information delivery to guests with regards to history, cultural heritage as well as natural particularities of the property and destination. Additionally, responsible for daily activities, in line with One&Only Gorillas nest services and functionalities. When necessary and appropriate accompanying guests on arranged excursions and activities.
Key Duties And Responsibilities

 Responsible for finding the best quality, high-end providers and activities in the area. 
 Ensure that allocated guests receive the activities, tours and excursions in an informed, timely and professional manner, while respecting the policies, procedures and systems of One&Only Gorillas Nest . This is to be carried out by maintaining personal contact with the guest and providing continuity to the guests’ interactions with the other departments of the One&Only Gorillas Nest . 
 Arrange on and off-site activities, tours/transfers and special requests of guests ensuring maximum comfort and convenience for the duration of their visit. 
 Be responsible for a particular zone of the resorts’ reserve area, with regards to ecological maintenance, security and monitoring, and to ensure its’ sound development as part of an integrated environmental policy for the property. 
 Report on any maintenance needs relevant Department/s. 
 Maintain an updated deep and comprehensive knowledge of the resort’s services, its function and offerings. Actively enquire and recommend services and activities to guests and visitors, ensuring that they are kept informed of the full range of options available to them. 
 As directed, carry out property conservation and land care work that include but are not limited to the maintenance of decks, shelters, tracks and trails, slashing and mowing, maintenance of fences, planting and maintaining flora, and the removal of deceased wildlife from the property. 
 Report to your assigned working area according to the scheduled roster, correctly groomed and in a condition to perform assigned duties. 
 Take a proactive approach to ensuring the guests experience is memorable by participating in guest activities, as required, within the scope of responsibilities. 
 Respond to emergency situations based on property’s emergency procedures and ensure that in these situations the safety of the people and the protection of company equipment is adequately. 
 It is your responsibility to know what these are at all times. 
 Adheres to all resort policies, procedures and standards laid out by One&Only Resorts.

Skills, Experience & Educational Requirements
Knowledge & Skills

 Any of the following specialized areas of interest, ability or training would be relevant: 

 Knowledge of African and Rwandan flora and fauna, natural history, history and culture. 
 Natural Sciences. 
 Professional guiding with Knowledge of wildlife 
 Fluency in English is essential; any additional languages are preferable. 

3 Core VAlues & Competencies
Blow Away The Customer

 I care and work towards exceeding the expectations of my customers 
 I am proactive and deliver unique and everlasting memories for our customers

Develop Passionate and Committed People

 I am committed to being thoughtful towards our colleagues 
 I am passionate about my role

Continuously Strive for Perfections (good enough never is)

 I constantly seek new ways and ideas to improve what I do 
 I am inspired to make a difference

Achieve Sustainable Bottom Line Performance

 I am honest and fair 
 I take responsibility and contribute towards the financial performance of where I work

4 Functional competencies
Grooming

 I present a professional image according to established standards

Communication

 I speak in a clear and concise manner both in person and over the phone 
 I express ideas in a clear and coherent manner

Functional Skills and Knowledge

 I demonstrate my knowledge and skills effectively 
 I take responsibility for my actions

Time Keeping & Grooming

 I report for work in my department on time daily

Response to Supervision

 I demonstrate respect for my leaders 
 I respond to supervision positively

Our brand is expanding faster than ever before. We are investing in the growth of our company, and that means we are committed to investing in you. Join a team that is open-hearted, intuitive, generous, and spontaneous in spirit. We believe in making our guests happy beyond anything they have ever imagined. We wow them at every turn and create memories that will last a lifetime. You will be at the heart of this vision, to constantly innovate to deliver Amazing Experiences and Everlasting Memories.

brightermonday.title: Customer Experience Agent
brightermonday.description:
Job descriptions & requirements

customer.
Job Description
Customer Experience Agent : JL2
Maersk is looking for a customer-focused and proactive Customer Experience Agent to join our team in Kigali, Rwanda. In this role, you will be responsible for managing the end-to-end customer experience, building strong relationships with customers, coordinating service delivery, and ensuring operational excellence across the supply chain journey.
You will work closely with customers, field operations teams, agents, and internal stakeholders to deliver exceptional service while driving customer satisfaction, profitability, and business growth.
WHAT WE OFFER:
When you join Maersk, you’ll find that the world is your workplace. You’ll work in a culturally diverse, stimulating environment, surrounded by new ideas and different ways of doing things. We believe in individual performance within highly professional teams supported by our distinctive values. To us teamwork means acceptance, respect, dedication, and the idea that we can achieve more when we all pull together.
Living our values means competing in the marketplace in an ethical way so our name is synonymous with being a credible and valuable business partner. Through Constant Care and Humbleness, we strive to prepare for the future, while never forgetting that our customers and competitors are key to our ability to improve. In our daily work Uprightness and Our Employees mean that transparency and accountability in everything we do go hand in hand with being an inspiring, challenging place to work. At Maersk, we take pride in hiring the best person for the job – irrespective of gender, age, nationality, or religious belief.
Key Responsibilities

Maintain close contact with assigned key clients and respond to any queries arising in service delivery
Responsible for end-to-end shipment order journey
Maintain close contact with our field operations to ensure excellent service delivery to guarantee sustainable business relationship with both the agents and the clients
Maintain close contact with our agents to ensure excellent service delivery to guarantee sustainable business relationship with both the agents and the clients
Drive the team’s operations by planning duties with field team and other functions as when field jobs arise. Follow up via field visits to ensure work is done effectively and efficiently to the client satisfaction.
In liaison with the Head of Department, execute business development strategies for weekly/monthly customer performance reviews.
Keep track of the P&L of all jobs handled to ensure we remain as profitable as per commercial SLI
Flag any direct or indirect costs that have a negative impact to profitability
Dispatch of customer invoices & other related documents
Offer solutions to customer queries and disputes
Execute the company’s overall objective through collaboration with other team members, other functions, and supervisor/department head
Coordinate CHB, VAS, Trucking, Warehousing, and any other services as may be requested by customer/line manager
Capture Voice of Customer frequently and provide feedback to the team to improve inland delivery performance and experience
Handle system updates and customer requests in accordance with defined processes
Ensure all relevant costs are timely updated in systems and ensure charges are passed on to customer
Upselling & cross selling of LnS opportunities.
Other ad hoc assignments as may be given to you by your line manager

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
Someone with:

Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, International Trade, or a related field.
At least 2 years' experience in customer service within freight forwarding and logistics.
Customer-centric mindset.
Good knowledge of MS Excel and experience working with multiple systems.
Fluency in English is a must.
Problem-solving and critical thinking skills.
Teamwork and collaborative mindset.
Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills.
Strong stakeholder management skills.
Customer orientation, collaboration, and agility.
Ability to effectively prioritize workload and manage multiple tasks.
Good understanding of INCOTERMS, customs documentation, and import/export processes.
Experience in the logistics industry will be an added advantage.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and deliver results.
Strong business acumen and the ability to build value-based relationships with customers and stakeholders.

#RPO
Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.
We are happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. If you need special assistance or an accommodation to use our website, apply for a position, or to perform a job, please contact us by emailing accommodationrequests@maersk.com.

brightermonday.description:
Job descriptions & requirements

Additional Information
Job Number 26124431
Job Category Food and Beverage & Culinary
Location KN 3 Avenue, Nyarugenge District, Kigali, RWANDAVIEW ON MAP
Schedule Full Time
Located Remotely? N
Position Type Non-Management
Notre travail ne se limite pas à mettre de la nourriture sur la table dont nos clients se régaleront jusqu'à ce qu'ils demandent leur facture. Nous devons avant tout bâtir une expérience unique et mémorable – en plus de la nourriture et des boissons. Nos experts en Service client font preuve d'initiative et offrent un vaste éventail de services afin que le repas de nos clients soit mémorable. Que ce soit mettre la table, communiquer avec la cuisine, interagir avec le client et le servir, ou nettoyer les zones de travail et les fournitures, l'expert en Service client fait en sorte que les clients sentent que les transactions font partie de l'expérience.
Peu importe votre poste, certaines choses sont essentielles pour réussir - la création d'un lieu de travail sécuritaire, le respect des politiques et des procédures de la société, le respect des normes de qualité et veiller à ce que votre uniforme, votre apparence personnelle et vos communications soient professionnels. Le rôle d'expert en Service client signifie être sur vos pieds et vous déplacer (se lever, s’asseoir ou marcher pendant une longue période de temps); se déplacer sur des surfaces en pente, inégales ou glissantes; gérer le menu (lire et vérifier l'information visuellement), et mettre la main à la pâte dans votre travail (déplacer, soulever, porter, pousser, tirer et placer des objets pesant jusqu’à 25 livres (11,4 kg) sans assistance et 50 livres (22,7 kg) avec assistance; atteindre les objets au-dessus de la tête et au-dessous des genoux, y compris se plier, faire des rotations du corps, tirer et se baisser). Il est essentiel que les experts en Service client exécutent toutes ces tâches à la perfection (et toute autre tâche raisonnable qui leur est assignée) - ainsi, nos clients seront toujours satisfaits et notre entreprise continuera de prospérer.
Qualifications Recommandées
Niveau d’études:Diplôme d’études secondaires ou équivalence de niveau secondaire.
Expérience de travail connexe:Moins d’un an d’expérience de travail connexe.
Expérience de supervision:Aucune expérience de supervision.
Permis ou certification:Aucune
Chez Marriott International, nous nous engageons à promouvoir l’égalité d’accès à l’emploi, à accueillir dignement chaque personne et à offrir les mêmes opportunités à tous. Nous avons instauré un environnement dans lequel les particularités de nos collaborateurs sont appréciées et célébrées. Notre plus grande force réside dans le mélange varié de cultures, de compétences et d’expériences de nos collaborateurs. Nous veillons à prévenir toute discrimination fondée sur des critères protégés, notamment le handicap, le statut de vétéran et tout autre aspect couvert par la loi en vigueur.
Les établissements Marriott Hotels s'efforcent d'élever l'art de l'hôtellerie en innovant dès qu'ils le peuvent tout en préservant le confort propre à ce qui nous est familier partout dans le monde. En tant que collaborateur ou collaboratrice Marriott Hotels, vous nous aiderez à tenir notre promesse, celle d'une hôtellerie de qualité, toujours (« Wonderful Hospitality. Always »), en offrant un service attentionné, sincère et novateur qui respecte et développe ce patrimoine vivant. Avec notre nom synonyme d'hôtellerie partout dans le monde, nous vous accueillons avec fierté pour découvrir les possibilités de carrière chez Marriott Hotels. En rejoignant Marriott Hotels, vous intégrerez le portefeuille d'enseignes de Marriott International. Rejoignez une entreprise qui vous donne la possibilité de donner le meilleur de vous-même, de trouver un sens à votre vie professionnelle, de faire partie d'une équipe internationale d'exception et de devenir la meilleure version de vous-même.
JW Marriott fait partie du portefeuille d'établissements de luxe de Marriott International et se compose de plus de 100 superbes établissements situés dans les villes portes d'accès à leur région et dans les plus beaux sites de villégiature partout dans le monde. Pour JW, nos collaborateurs et collaboratrices passent en premier. Parce que si vous vous sentez bien, notre clientèle le sera aussi. Les collaborateurs et collaboratrices JW Marriott sont des personnes assurées, innovantes, authentiques et intuitives qui poursuivent l'héritage laissé par le fondateur de l'entreprise J. Willard Marriott, à qui l'enseigne doit son nom. Nos hôtels offrent une expérience de travail unique, où vous ferez partie d'une communauté et vivrez une véritable camaraderie avec un groupe de collègues varié. JW offre des opportunités de formation, de développement et de reconnaissance et, plus important encore, un endroit où nourrir vos passions dans un environnement luxueux qui met l'accent sur un bien-être holistique. Traiter notre clientèle de façon exceptionnelle, c'est d'abord prendre soin de nos collaborateurs et collaboratrices. C'est ce que nous appelons The JW Treatment™. En rejoignant JW Marriott, vous intégrerez le portefeuille d'enseignes de Marriott International. Rejoignez une entreprise qui vous donne la possibilité de donner le meilleur de vous-même, de trouver un sens à votre vie professionnelle, de faire partie d'une équipe internationale d'exception et de devenir la meilleure version de vous-même.

brightermonday.title: Sous Chef
brightermonday.description:
Job descriptions & requirements

( 12182 )
At One&Only, we exist to create joy for our guests through anticipation, creativity, precision, empathy and warmth. We tailor every aspect of our guests’ stay to bring their dreams and desires to life. With an atmosphere that’s chic but wonderfully unstuffy™, and a team who are meticulous but warm, we seek to exceed our guests’ expectations at every possible turn.
Cushioned in the foothills of the breath-taking Virunga Volcano Range, One&Only Gorilla’s Nest makes the magical possible to enjoy a once-in-a-lifetime, personal encounter with the rare and majestic mountain gorilla, roaming free in its own natural habitat. The warm African charm is one of our most unique and valued assets. With abundant knowledge and generosity, we anticipate our guest’s every need and surpass expectations. Whether we are designing the perfect day out or arranging a romantic private dinner, we approach everything with imagination to spark a sense of playfulness, discovery and adventure. This is not simply our job, it’s our passion. We don’t just exist in the environment, we exist with the environment; from working the land or building a shelter, we like to give back in as many ways as we can to help our communities flourish.
Job Description – Sous Chef

 Position Details
 Position Sous Chef 
 Level Assistant Manager 
 Department Culinary 
 Reports to Executive Chef 
 Subordinates Chefs & Stewards 
 Job Details & Requirements

At One&Only our passion is to create moments of joy, where guests can truly let loose, forget the world and feel alive.
Our Colleagues are tuned-in and are the beating heart of our brand. We don’t just operate amazing resorts, we create joy in
everything we do.
Due to the location and complexities of the operation at One and Only Gorilla’s Nest, you will be required to work in other departments as and when required and support the team to deliver the customer experience.
Job Summary
To support the Executive Chef in ensuring the food offering is of the required standard of One&Only. Ensure all important information is communicated with the direct supervisor. All HACCP standards are followed and improved consistently. Ensure all guest request are handled with care and accommodated where possible. Maintain highest levels of personal hygiene and grooming at all times, as per standard. Consistently train the Subordinates, to ensure the standards are maintained. Ensure the operating equipment is maintained and inventory level is in order. Ensure daily and weekly ordering of products is in accordance with the occupation of the Lodge. Assists Executive Chef to lead the Team in the assigned area.
Key Duties And Responsibilities

 Be familiar with work place policies, rules and procedures 
 At all times, adhere to: Colleague handbook, group and unit policies, departmental operating procedures/work flows, ad hoc communication (notices, instructions by management, meetings, etc..), legal and contractual obligations (health and safety, good faith, conditions of employment) 
 Ensures the quality levels of kitchen production and presentation is maintained at its highest level at all times. 
 Creates new products, 
 be innovative and strive for change, continually be up to date with food trends and fashion 
 Presents oneself in a way that enhances the overall guest experience, by adding life and energy into each outlet. 
 Ensures that all mise en place is correctly prepared prior to commencing service. 
 Demonstrates excellent product knowledge of all food and special functions held at the Lodge. 
 Participates in the service of any special functions or events organized by the Lodge. 
 Monitors systematically the performance of the department and intervenes immediately if deviations occur. 
 Attends the daily Department Head meeting in absence of the Executive Chef. 
 Ensures all food requisitions are prepared within the time parameters, set by the Lodge and always displays attributes of genuine hospitality. 
 Conducts performance appraisals for kitchen Colleagues. 
 Monitors colleague’s compliance to job profiles 
 Check and insure all colleagues are on duty and keep attendance register 
 With Executive chef do development interviews with colleagues (highlight training needs, decided on a plan of action and track progress) on a quarterly basis, in conjunction with performance appraisals 
 Establishes and maintains smooth personal and work relationships in the kitchen. 
 Remains current on all Lodge happenings, including guests in-house, arrivals and departures, as well as daily events. 
 Assists supervisors in generating work schedules for kitchen personnel, according to forecasted demand requirements. 
 Performs any additional or special duties, as directed by the Executive Chef. 
 Ordering and keeping fair stocks. 
 Minimizing wastage through creative recycling. 
 Ensures expiree dates are labeled on products that are required. 
 Does regular spot checks on all expiry items. 
 Responsible of the daily market list during the absence of the Executive Chef. 
 Maintains highest levels of personal hygiene and grooming at all times, as per standard. 
 Ensures that a safe, hygienically fit working environment is maintained at all times and reports any concerns or faults immediately. 
 Arrange regular deep cleaning of the kitchen and maintain hygiene procedures and controls 
 All food to be wrapped, marked, dated and stored on designated shelves at correct temperature 
 Ongoing - 95% quarterly hygiene audit score 
 Ensures kitchen and back areas are thoroughly clean always. 
 Ensures that equipment is cleaned, when necessary or according to their schedules. 
 Maintains and creates a working environment that reflects a sense of place. 
 Attends the daily kitchen briefings. 
 Continuously trains and motivates subordinates to ensure Lodges standards are maintained. 
 Delegates responsibilities to Colleagues and ensures tasks are completed. 
 Ensures that channels of communication are respected, and information is disseminated to the correct receivers. 
 Convene daily, weekly and monthly departmental meetings 
 Attends monthly communication meetings. 
 Conducts a daily briefing prior to service. 
 Attends all training carried out by the Training Department, executive chef and management 
 In-depth training of his/her Colleagues. 
 Attends weekly F&B meetings F&B meeting. 
 Conducts a monthly communication meeting. 
 Conducts a daily briefing prior to service and a debriefing, once week with Colleagues. 
 Assists in the process of recruiting new employees for each of the respective kitchen. 
 When driving Lodge’s buggies, ensures that rules and regulations are followed at all times. 
 Ensure a safe and healthy work environment for colleagues 
 Ensure that all equipment is accompanied by safety instructions on how to use and clean and insure colleagues are following procedures 
 All materials issued from the first aid box to be recorded to be replenished 
 Ensure all storage areas are locked after service 
 Handles any guest’s complaint in a professional manner, as per Lodge Policy & Procedure (service recovery). 
 Ensures that disciplinary actions are taken, when necessary, according to Lodge Policy & Procedure. 
 Practices proper telephone etiquette with Colleagues and Lodge’s guests. 
 Ensures excellent communication and working relationships with Colleagues are maintained and contribute to the team spirit. 
 Exhibits outstanding knowledge of the Lodge and Rwandan culture. 
 Knows and applies Lodge Policy & Procedure, including those for the emergency situations. 
 Ensures maintenance work is completed, in a timely and professional manner. 
 Ensures all fixed assets are well maintained. 
 Demonstrates knowledge and interest in goals, and objectives of the One&Only brand. 
 Ensures all activities are carried out honestly, ethically and within the parameters of the Rwandan Law. 
 Ensures that all tasks assigned by superiors are completed, in a timely fashion. 
 Should be in abidance with the expectations defined in the job responsibilities. 
 Completes and efficiently sets up of the respective kitchen. 
 Demonstrates individual productivity and work efficiency. 
 Training Colleagues and their performance. 
 Attends shifts with punctuality. 
 Align food cost within budget for the kitchen.

Skills, Experience & Educational Requirements

 Culinary Diploma and 2 work experience in a Lodge environment (preferable five star) is a valuable addition. 
 Work experiences in various types of cuisine and kitchen set-ups 
 Fluency in English is essential, any additional languages is preferable. 
 Intermediate HACCP certified 
 Intermediate computer competency including excel 
 Leadership program certified 
 Core VAlues & Competencies

Blow Away The Customer

 I care and work towards exceeding the expectations of my customers 
 I am proactive and deliver unique and everlasting memories for our customers

Develop Passionate and Committed People

 I am committed to being thoughtful towards our colleagues 
 I am passionate about my role

Continuously Strive for Perfections (good enough never is)

 I constantly seek new ways and ideas to improve what I do 
 I am inspired to make a difference

Achieve Sustainable Bottom Line Performance

 I am honest and fair 
 I take responsibility and contribute towards the financial performance of where I work 
 Functional competencies

Grooming

 I present a professional image according to established standards

Communication

 I adapt my communication to the audience and the message to be delivered 
 I am able to develop effective written communications

Functional Skills & Knowledge

 I understand the full scope of my duties and demonstrate initiative 
 I take responsibility for my actions

Planning & Organizing

 I set realistic goals both for myself and my colleagues in line with company strategies 
 I am capable of handling multiple priorities effectively

Team Management & Development (Influencing & Working With Others)

 I devote time in training and coaching each colleague 
 I conduct regular performance management discussions for my colleagues and monitor their progress

Where Colleagues do not have anyone to supervise,
then the competency will be replaced by with the following 2 behaviors:

 I am able to influence others when required to speak and present ideas 
 I am able to work with other colleagues and departments effectively

Problem Solving & Decision Making

 I have the ability to involve all the appropriate people to resolve problem in the business. 
 I proactively facilitate prompt and appropriate decision making

Innovation & Creativity

 I regularly seek new opportunities for change 
 I assist in resolving resistance to change 

Our brand is expanding faster than ever before. We are investing in the growth of our company, and that means we are committed to investing in you. Join a team that is open-hearted, intuitive, generous, and spontaneous in spirit. We believe in making our guests happy beyond anything they have ever imagined. We wow them at every turn and create memories that will last a lifetime. You will be at the heart of this vision, to constantly innovate to deliver Amazing Experiences and Everlasting Memories.
<
