ndangira.description:
Job Title: Banking Applications Administrator

Department: Information Technology

Reports to: Enterprise Application Supervisor

Purpose of the Role

The job holder is responsible for the administration, maintenance, availability, tuning and advanced support of the bank's business applications and their surrounding ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

Administer and maintain all banking surround systems and applications.

Ensure and monitor banking application’s health, performance, and availability.

Act as first escalation point for enterprise applications.

Troubleshoot and resolve application incidents/service disruptions within bank’s SLA.

Coordinate application upgrades, patches, and releases.

Ensure applications logs are regularly maintained and saved for future reference.

Maintain application documentation for both external and in-house developed software.

Obtain and evaluate all relevant information of application software complaints and suggest resolution to direct supervisor.

Create, modify, and revoke user accounts and profiles for administered applications by adhering to user management policy.

Act as Level 2 and Level 3 support for application-related issues by analysing root causes, coordinating with vendors and internal teams for resolution.

Assess and implement approved application changes.

Support application releases in accordance with change management procedures.

Maintain application documentation and release records.

Monitor application transactions, response times, and processing performance.

Identify bottlenecks and recommend improvements.

Tune application settings and configurations for optimal performance.

Support application backup and restoration procedures.

Participate in Disaster Recovery (DR) testing exercises.

Ensure applications are recoverable within the agreed Recovery Time Objective (RTO) and Recovery Point Objective (RPO).

Ensure application security standards are implemented and maintained.

Be ready to provide support during late hours, holidays, and weekends in response to needs of the systems being supported or as per planned roster or in case of emergency.

Maintain software application information confidentiality strictly.

Ensure compliance with bank Policies and Information Technology Procedures.

Knowledge, Skills and Experience Required

Education

Possess a bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Development, APIs Development and Deployment, or any other related field.

Experience

Have at least 1/2 to 2 years of experience in developing and maintaining banking applications.

Hands-on and thorough knowledge in writing clean scripts.

Hands-on and proven experience in troubleshooting Java, C++ codes related issues.

Hands-on in configuring and managing enterprise applications.

Experience in developing and exposing APIs is an added advantage.

Experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD).

Key Skills and Competencies

Advanced knowledge in modern programming languages like: Python, JavaScript, Java, SQL, Oracle, etc.

Knowledge of object-oriented programming.

Knowledge of RESTful APIs.

Knowledge of RDBMS for data analysis.

Knowledge of systems integrations.

Numeric, oral, and written language applications.

Ability to collaborate easily and effectively within a team and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to work autonomously and think strategically.

Strong teamwork development and spirit.

Application Requirements

Interested candidates are invited to submit:

A detailed CV outlining relevant experience.

A cover letter outlining their suitability for the role.

Please send your application to hr.recruitment@imbank.co.rw.

PS: The email subject should contain the title “Banking Applications Administrator”.

Deadline for applications: October 5th, 2026

Job Title: E-Channels Supervisor

Reports to: Enterprise Application Manager

Department: Information Technology

Purpose of the Role

The job holder is responsible for designing and delivering robust, secure, and scalable e-Channel applications especially Internet and Mobile Banking by leading the full software development lifecycle, driving technical excellence, and aligning technology solutions with the bank's strategic objectives and regulatory requirements. She/He is responsible for the administration, maintenance, availability, performance and advanced support of the bank's e-channel applications.

Key Responsibilities

Administer full digital product lifecycle from discovery to optimization and maintenance.

Ensure high availability, reliability, and performance of e-channels include but not limited to Mobile & Mobile Banking (with USSD).

Monitor channel’s transaction success rates, response times, system capacity to optimize availability.

Constant development of initiatives that promote accessibility, usability and consistency across e-banking channels.

Design channel requirements, evaluate development dependencies, review BRDs and FRDs to guide and align solutioning.

Troubleshoot & resolve e-channels incidents and service disruptions within bank’s SLA.

Act as advanced resources for support of e-channels’ related issues by analysing root causes, coordinating with vendors and internal teams.

Ensure e-banking application’s logs are regularly maintained and saved for future reference.

Create, modify, and revoke user accounts and profiles for e-channels applications by adhering to user management policy.

Manage, assess and implement approved application changes.

Install and manage e-channels releases in accordance with change management procedures.

Manage relationships with e-channels vendors.

Work with internal IT teams to ensure digital solutions are scalable to support increasing transaction volumes.

Ensures service level agreement (SLA) with vendors are met.

Ensure e-channels comply with application regulations and compliance.

Constant identification of e-channel’s bottlenecks and recommend improvements.

Participate in Disaster Recovery (DR) testing exercises.

Ensure applications are recoverable within the agreed Recovery Time Objective (RTO) and Recovery Point Objective (RPO).

Be ready to provide support during late hours, holidays, and weekends in response to needs of the systems being supported or as per planned roaster or in case of emergency.

Ensure application security standards are implemented and maintained.

Maintain application architecture and operational documentation.

Maintain software application information confidentiality strictly.

Ensure compliance with bank Policies and Information Technology Procedures.

Knowledge, Skills and Experience Required

Possess a bachelor’s degree in software development, APIs Development and Deployment, or any other related field.

Have at least 3-5 years of relevant experience in banking technology, digital banking or digital payment.

Thorough knowledge and experience in writing front and backend scripts.

Hands-on and proven experience in troubleshooting Java, C++ codes related issues.

Hands-on in configure and manage e-channels applications.

Experience in developing and expose APIs is an added advantage.

Advanced knowledge in modern programming languages like: Python, Java Script, Java, SQL, Oracle etc.

Knowledge of oriented object programming.

Knowledge of RESTful APIs.

Knowledge of RDBMS for data analysis.

Knowledge of banking systems integrations.

Numeric, oral, and written language applications.

Experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD).

Ability to collaborate easily and effectively within a team and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Excellent Analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to work autonomously.

Ability to think strategically.

Teamwork development and spirit.

Application Requirements

Interested candidates are invited to submit:

A detailed CV outlining relevant experience.

A cover letter outlining their suitability for the role.

Please send your application to hr.recruitment@imbank.co.rw.

Job Title: Database Administrator

Reports to: Database Administration Supervisor

Department: Information Technology

Purpose of the Role

The jobholder will be responsible for the development, maintenance and security of the bank’s data and databases (all) by ensuring the continuous availability, safety, and speed-to-access of the bank’s databases.

Key Responsibilities

Perform database management routines by doing a daily health-check, data sizing, database patching, 24/7 monitoring, data backup, and replication checks.

Knowledge in Database tuning.

Analysing and tuning of database’s performance through query optimization, index management and configurations.

Proven hands-on on data extraction, data recovery, data security and integrity.

Maintain all bank’s database privileges by adding, updating, or deleting backend users.

Perform a regular database maintenance and keep book log for the maintenance.

Develop and implement capacity planning strategies to support business growth.

Participate in the development, implementation, and maintenance of a comprehensive Bank disaster recovery plan.

Participate in periodic data backups and disaster drills.

Maintaining data standards, including adherence to professional database problem solving and change management procedures.

Maintain datacentre’s information confidentiality strictly.

Perform database and application monitoring for replications.

Ensure compliance to IT Policies and Procedures.

Participate in datacentre’s auditing activities.

Be ready to provide support during late hours, holidays, and weekends in response to needs of the systems being supported or as per planned roaster or in case of emergency.

Perform any other duties as may be directed by the direct supervisor or The Head of IT.

Knowledge, Skills and Experience Required

A Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information systems, data or Information management or the equivalent.

Minimum of 3-5 years hands-on experience in database administration for MSSQL, Oracle DB or Postgres.

Expert-level knowledge of at least two major databases platforms (Oracle and SQL) & two major Operating Systems (Linux and Windows).

Hands-on and proven experience in troubleshooting database related issues.

Hands-on in configure and manage database backup and replications.

Relevant database professional certifications in Mango, MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, or Oracle is an added advantage.

Experience in managing multiple RDBMS on large systems.

Should have experience working with vendors/suppliers and managing SLA.

Practical experience in monitoring and tuning a database to provide a high availability service.

Excellent Analytical and problem-solving skills.

Ability to work autonomously.

Ability to manage multiple projects, activities, and tasks simultaneously.

Ability to think strategically.

Teamwork development and spirit.

Application Requirements

Interested candidates are invited to submit:

A detailed CV outlining relevant experience.

A cover letter outlining their suitability for the role.

Please send your application to hr.recruitment@imbank.co.rw.

ndangira.description:
JOB ANNOUNCEMENT

INDATWA SACCO RUSIZI is a saving and credit cooperative created through the consolidation of 18 Umurenge SACCOs operating in Rusizi District, in line with Rwanda’s SACCO reform agenda aimed at strengthening governance, capital adequacy, risk management, and service delivery. The consolidation complies with Law No. 057/2024 governing cooperatives and Law No. 072/2021 governing deposit-taking microfinance institutions, and aligns with BNR regulatory standards.

It is from that background that the Management of INDATWA SACCO RUSIZI informs the public that it is recruiting competent and qualified staff to fill the following positions:

S/N
Vacant Post
Number of Staff Required
Key Responsibilities & Requirements

1
Driver
1

Under the supervision and guidance of the Logistics and Procurement Officer, the Driver is responsible for:

Driving SACCO vehicles or motorcycles safely for authorized official activities.

Transporting staff, management, documents, and official materials as required.

Conducting daily checks and ensuring proper cleanliness and maintenance of the assigned vehicle or motorcycle.

Keeping accurate records of mileage, fuel consumption, servicing, and movements.

Reporting faults, accidents, and maintenance needs promptly.

Ensuring all required vehicle or motorcycle documents are valid.

Observing traffic laws, road safety requirements, and SACCO policies.

Performing other duties assigned by management.

Required Qualifications and Experience

At least a Secondary School Certificate (A2) or equivalent.

A valid driving permit for the category A & B 

At least 2 years of relevant professional driving experience.

Experience in driving for an organization or financial institution is an added advantage.

Good knowledge of road safety, traffic regulations, and basic vehicle/motorcycle maintenance.

Good communication skills, discipline, reliability, and a clean driving record.

General Requirement

To be Rwandan

Not to have been definitely sentenced to a term of imprisonment equal to or exceeding six (6) months;

Not to have been dismissed from any other institution unless applicant is entitled to reinstatement under laws and regulations in force;

Not have been involved in the bankruptcy of a financial institution;

Required Documents for application:

An application letter addressed to the Chairperson of BoD of INDATWA SACCO RUSIZI.

A detailed and updated Curriculum Vitae.

Copy of academic degree, Transcript and Certificate where Required.

A proof of work experience if any.

A photocopy of the Identity card.

Full addresses of three referees with recommendations letter, including preferably one of previous supervisors.

Submission of Applications

Interested and qualified candidates must submit their applications from their own email addresses to indatwa.rusizi@indatwa.dsacco.rw . Applications submitted using another person's email address will not be considered.

Application Deadline is the 5th October, 2026. 

Only a single document (PDF Format) will be considered

NB: E-mail subject should be the Applicant Names followed by a Position is applying for.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for the next stage of the recruitment process. Done at Rusizi on the 21st September, 2026.

SEMUCYO Alsene Managing Director INDATWA SACCO RUSIZI

ndangira.title_raw: Researcher / Research Scholar - Education, Human Capital and Demography in Rwanda at IIASA - International Institute for Applied Systems Analysis: ( Deadline 25 October 2026)
ndangira.company: International Institute for Applied Systems Analysis
ndangira.company_name: International Institute for Applied Systems Analysis
ndangira.description:
Job Description

Multidimensional Demographic Modeling (MDM) - rEsearch group

The Multidimensional Demographic Modeling (MDM) Research Group, part of the IIASA Population and Just Societies (POPJUS) Program is looking to recruit a motivated early-career researcher (either in the final stage of a PhD or at postdoctoral level) for 12 months to join an international research project in collaboration with the University of Cape Town on modelling human capital formation in Africa.

BACKGROUND

The position is part of the project “Human Capital for Sustainable Development: A Focus on Africa and Coastal Regions”, under the leadership of IIASA Distinguished Emeritus Research Scholar Wolfgang Lutz. The project is supported by the 2024 Yidan Prize for Education Research, awarded to Wolfgang Lutz, and builds on IIASA’s longstanding research on population dynamics, education, and human capital. It applies multidimensional demographic modelling and detailed evidence on educational change to investigate how near-term investments in education can translate into long-term improvements in human capital, and what this means for health, gender equity, poverty reduction, and resilience to environmental change. The project seeks to improve understanding of how investments in education shape long-term development pathways and to provide rigorous evidence to support decision-making in countries facing major demographic, social, and environmental challenges.

THE ROLE

The successful candidate will contribute to the development of a country case study on education and human capital in Rwanda. The work will involve analyzing demographic, educational, and socioeconomic data and applying quantitative methods to examine educational change and its longer-term implications for human capital and population dynamics.

The position offers an opportunity to work at the intersection of demography, economics, statistics, education, and sustainable development, while contributing to research with relevance for evidence-informed policymaking in Rwanda and beyond.

The researcher will be part of a small and dynamic core research team at IIASA and will interact with a broader network of international researchers, partners, and fellows. Collaboration will include the Southern Africa Labour and Development Research Unit (SALDRU), based in the School of Economics at the University of Cape Town (UCT), as well as other project partners and research collaborators.

The position is for one year. Depending on the needs of the project, the work will involve periods based at IIASA in Laxenburg, Austria, as well as travels for project-related meetings, workshops, and research activities.

The selected candidate will enjoy significant independence and full credit for their contributions, and the opportunity to build a record of peer-reviewed academic publications. Other outputs could be conference presentations and technical reports.

MAIN tASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Contribute to the design and implementation of a case study on education, human capital, and demographic change in Rwanda.

Analyze and harmonize demographic, educational, and socioeconomic data.

Apply appropriate statistical and quantitative methods to investigate educational and human capital outcomes.

Contribute to multidimensional demographic analyses and projections.

Interpret findings in the context of sustainable development and policy priorities.

Contribute to scientific publications, reports, presentations, and other project outputs.

Engage with researchers and project partners at IIASA, SALDRU/UCT, and other collaborating institutions.

Participate in research meetings, workshops, and other project activities as appropriate.

SKILLS, QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Education and Background

PhD in the final stage of completion or a completed PhD, preferably in economics, statistics, demography, population studies, development studies, or a related field.

Essential skills and competencies:

Strong quantitative background and demonstrated experience with statistical and/or econometric methods.

Experience working with demographic, educational, socioeconomic, or other large-scale survey or administrative datasets.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

The ability to work independently while contributing effectively to an interdisciplinary and international research team.

Excellent written and spoken English; and proficiency in Kinyarwanda.

Ability to work well as part of a team and independently.

Desirable skills:

Experience with demographic modelling, population projections, or the analysis of education and labor-market data would be an advantage

IIASA offers an interdisciplinary and international workplace, and the possibility to interact with researchers of different nationalities, with strong ties to a world-wide network of research institutions engaged in environmental systems research. The successful candidate must be able to work in, and have respect for, an intercultural environment, and IIASA core values.

APPOINTMENT TERMS

The successful candidate should be available to take up the position as soon as possible - No later than February 2027.

The place of work is IIASA in Laxenburg, near Vienna, Austria (home office options available).

The successful candidate will be appointed as a researcher (R1) OR Research Scholar (R2) depending on qualifications and experience and in accordance with the IIASA profiles for research careers.

We offer

1-year full-time fixed-term contract (100%, 40 hrs/week), with NOpossibility of extension thereafter.

An attractive annual salary starting at EUR 42,374, exempt from income tax in Austria (social insurance deductions still apply), negotiable depending on the research level you are appointed to.

The possibility to work in an international, interdisciplinary research environment at IIASA and to collaborate closely with researchers at SALDRU/UCT and other academic and policy partners.

The opportunity to :

develop an in-depth research case study on education and human capital in Rwanda;

work with advanced demographic and quantitative methods;

interact with a vibrant research community, comprising both a close-knit core project team and a wider network of international collaborators and fellows;

gain experience in translating rigorous quantitative research into findings relevant to policy and sustainable development; and

participate in international research activities and, where appropriate, project-related travel.

An international atmosphere and pleasant working environment in a historic market town surrounded by green areas.

IIASA salaries are:

Not directly comparable with other employers in Austria, due to the unique legal status and privileges granted to IIASA.

Subject to the principle of income aggregation (Progressionsvorbehalt in German).

additional BENEFITS

Educational subsidies for children of school age enrolled in private schools in Austria.

A generous annual leave entitlement.

Relocation allowances and paid home leave for employees who are hired from international locations.

Assistance for newcomers to Austria with visa, work and residency permit applications.

Support finding accommodation in Austria.

Further details here.

About IIASA

IIASA is committed to a working environment that promotes equality, diversity, tolerance and inclusion within its workforce. This is reflected in our IIASA core values. We encourage qualified candidates from all religious, ethnic, and social backgrounds to apply. In the case that candidates are equally qualified, preference will be given to applicants from countries where IIASA has a Member Organization.

Further Information

For further information about this opportunity please contact:

ANDRUCHOWITZ Stefanie – Project Officer

LUTZ Wolfgang – IIASA Sherpa for Asia (DG); Distinguished Emeritus Research Scholar

BATSHONE Amer - Recruitment related questions

Applications

In order to apply for this opportunity, you will need to provide the following documents in English:

A cover letter outlining your motivation for and fit to the position.

A detailed Curriculum Vitae and a recent example of your research work

The names, addresses (including e-mail), and telephone numbers of two reference givers.

Deadline for receipt of applications: 25 October 2026

Applications

In order to apply for this opportunity, you will need to provide the following documents in English:

A cover letter outlining your motivation for and fit to the position.

A detailed Curriculum Vitae and a recent example of your research work

The names, addresses (including e-mail), and telephone numbers of two reference givers.

Deadline for receipt of applications: 25 October 2026

Job Description

Multidimensional Demographic Modeling (MDM) - rEsearch group

The Multidimensional Demographic Modeling (MDM) Research Group, part of the IIASA Population and Just Societies (POPJUS) Program is looking to recruit a motivated early-career researcher (either in the final stage of a PhD or at postdoctoral level) for 12 months to join an international research project in collaboration with the University of Cape Town on modelling human capital formation in Africa.

BACKGROUND

The position is part of the project “Human Capital for Sustainable Development: A Focus on Africa and Coastal Regions”, under the leadership of IIASA Distinguished Emeritus Research Scholar Wolfgang Lutz. The project is supported by the 2024 Yidan Prize for Education Research, awarded to Wolfgang Lutz, and builds on IIASA’s longstanding research on population dynamics, education, and human capital. It applies multidimensional demographic modelling and detailed evidence on educational change to investigate how near-term investments in education can translate into long-term improvements in human capital, and what this means for health, gender equity, poverty reduction, and resilience to environmental change. The project seeks to improve understanding of how investments in education shape long-term development pathways and to provide rigorous evidence to support decision-making in countries facing major demographic, social, and environmental challenges.

THE ROLE

The successful candidate will contribute to the development of a country case study on education and human capital in Rwanda. The work will involve analyzing demographic, educational, and socioeconomic data and applying quantitative methods to examine educational change and its longer-term implications for human capital and population dynamics.

The position offers an opportunity to work at the intersection of demography, economics, statistics, education, and sustainable development, while contributing to research with relevance for evidence-informed policymaking in Rwanda and beyond.

The researcher will be part of a small and dynamic core research team at IIASA and will interact with a broader network of international researchers, partners, and fellows. Collaboration will include the Southern Africa Labour and Development Research Unit (SALDRU), based in the School of Economics at the University of Cape Town (UCT), as well as other project partners and research collaborators.

The position is for one year. Depending on the needs of the project, the work will involve periods based at IIASA in Laxenburg, Austria, as well as travels for project-related meetings, workshops, and research activities.

The selected candidate will enjoy significant independence and full credit for their contributions, and the opportunity to build a record of peer-reviewed academic publications. Other outputs could be conference presentations and technical reports.

MAIN tASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Contribute to the design and implementation of a case study on education, human capital, and demographic change in Rwanda.

Analyze and harmonize demographic, educational, and socioeconomic data.

Apply appropriate statistical and quantitative methods to investigate educational and human capital outcomes.

Contribute to multidimensional demographic analyses and projections.

Interpret findings in the context of sustainable development and policy priorities.

Contribute to scientific publications, reports, presentations, and other project outputs.

Engage with researchers and project partners at IIASA, SALDRU/UCT, and other collaborating institutions.

Participate in research meetings, workshops, and other project activities as appropriate.

SKILLS, QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Education and Background

PhD in the final stage of completion or a completed PhD, preferably in economics, statistics, demography, population studies, development studies, or a related field.

Essential skills and competencies:

Strong quantitative background and demonstrated experience with statistical and/or econometric methods.

Experience working with demographic, educational, socioeconomic, or other large-scale survey or administrative datasets.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

The ability to work independently while contributing effectively to an interdisciplinary and international research team.

Excellent written and spoken English; and proficiency in Kinyarwanda.

Ability to work well as part of a team and independently.

Desirable skills:

Experience with demographic modelling, population projections, or the analysis of education and labor-market data would be an advantage

IIASA offers an interdisciplinary and international workplace, and the possibility to interact with researchers of different nationalities, with strong ties to a world-wide network of research institutions engaged in environmental systems research. The successful candidate must be able to work in, and have respect for, an intercultural environment, and IIASA core values.

APPOINTMENT TERMS

The successful candidate should be available to take up the position as soon as possible - No later than February 2027.

The place of work is IIASA in Laxenburg, near Vienna, Austria (home office options available).

The successful candidate will be appointed as a researcher (R1) OR Research Scholar (R2) depending on qualifications and experience and in accordance with the IIASA profiles for research careers.

We offer

1-year full-time fixed-term contract (100%, 40 hrs/week), with NOpossibility of extension thereafter.

An attractive annual salary starting at EUR 42,374, exempt from income tax in Austria (social insurance deductions still apply), negotiable depending on the research level you are appointed to.

The possibility to work in an international, interdisciplinary research environment at IIASA and to collaborate closely with researchers at SALDRU/UCT and other academic and policy partners.

The opportunity to :

develop an in-depth research case study on education and human capital in Rwanda;

work with advanced demographic and quantitative methods;

interact with a vibrant research community, comprising both a close-knit core project team and a wider network of international collaborators and fellows;

gain experience in translating rigorous quantitative research into findings relevant to policy and sustainable development; and

participate in international research activities and, where appropriate, project-related travel.

An international atmosphere and pleasant working environment in a historic market town surrounded by green areas.

ndangira.title: Rwanda Driver (Fixed-Term)  at One Acre Fund
ndangira.title_raw: Rwanda Driver (Fixed-Term)  at One Acre Fund: (Deadline 16-12-2026)
ndangira.description:
About One Acre Fund

Founded in 2006, One Acre Fund equips 5.5 million smallholder farmers to make their farms more productive. Across nine countries that together are home to two-thirds of Africa's farmers, we provide high-quality farm supplies, tree seedlings, accessible credit, modern agronomic training, and a wide range of other agricultural services. On average, this model enables any farmer to increase their income and assets on supported land by more than 35 percent, while permanently improving their resilience. This is all made possible by our team of 9,000+ full-time staff, drawn from diverse backgrounds and professions. To learn more, please see our Why Work Here blog post.

Our Rwanda program, founded in 2007 is our largest and operates under the local brand Tubura. We have more than 3,000 staff across all four provinces of Rwanda, as well as in Kigali. Together, we served more than 2.8 million farmers in 2024. We work closely with the government to support national efforts to improve food security. Additionally, we help channel funding and resources to promising agri-SMEs, supporting farmers by providing a market for high-impact crops such as coffee, avocado, and chili.

About the Role

Seeking a driver to transport agricultural and non-agricultural inputs between OAF sites, maintain the fleet and cargo in excellent condition, and provide insights on truck operations and charging to inform future electric truck ownership.

Responsibilities

Cargo Transport

Transport agricultural and non-agricultural inputs between assigned OAF sites, ensuring delivery strictly to the specified locations within set timelines.

Collaborate with the warehouse team to load, offload, and reload trucks, verifying that the physical cargo matches the exact quantity and quality stated on delivery documents.

Secure all materials in transit using appropriate equipment to prevent loss, theft, tampering, or damage (e.g., perforations, wet bags, or torn stitching).

Proactively gather information regarding the location and accessibility of field sites and chargers within the assigned district prior to departure.

Vehicle Maintenance

Conduct weekly vehicle checks, perform minor repairs, and submit maintenance requests to your manager to ensure that the vehicle under their care is kept in good running condition at all times.

Mitigate damage to the truck by avoiding risky routes or driving techniques.

Ensure safety and custody of the vehicles including tools.

Ensure availability of all the required documents/supplies including vehicle insurance, registration, first aid kit, and necessary spare parts in the assigned vehicle.

Ensure that, in the event of an accident involving the vehicle, the necessary steps required by rules and regulations are followed.

Documentation & Communication

Accurately manage all delivery documents, including Delivery Notes, Load Cards, and Truck Management Sheets (TMS). Return fully signed delivery documents to your manager within one (1) business day of delivery. 

Obtain official signatures from authorized OAF representatives at both the originating and destination sites to confirm the exact weight/number of inputs dispatched and received.

Immediately notify your manager via text (or call for urgent cases) in the event of accidents, field staff unavailability, data discrepancies, charging problems, mechanical problems, adverse weather, route accessibility issues, data discrepancies, or if any party refuses to sign the delivery documents.

Communicate regularly relevant trial information, such as GPS coordinates, KM range, battery levels, charging experience, driving experience, road quality, etc.

Ensure that all required driving training is successfully completed and certifications are kept up to date

Career Growth and Development

We have a strong culture of constant learning and we invest in developing our people. You’ll have weekly check-ins with your manager, access to mentorship and training programs, and regular feedback on your performance. We hold career reviews every six months, and set aside time to discuss your aspirations and career goals. You’ll have the opportunity to shape a growing organization and build a rewarding long-term career.

Qualifications

Across all roles, these are the general qualifications we look for. For this role specifically, you will have:

Valid category C driver’s licence

Experience driving cargo trucks on dirt roads outside of Kigali

Working knowledge of local roads and routes, ability to utilize maps / GPS systems

Working knowledge of electric vehicle mechanics (truck maintenance, interpret truck KM range / battery life)

Sound knowledge of road safety regulations

Effective communication skills (verbal and written) in Kinyarwanda

Punctual and reliable, customer service

Preferred Start Date

As soon as possible

Job Location

Kigali, Rwanda

Benefits

Health insurance, paid time off 

Contract Duration

3 months

Eligibility

This role is only open to citizens or permanent residents of Rwanda.

Application Deadline

23 December 2026. Please note that we hire on a rolling basis which means that applications are reviewed and processed on a continuous basis until a hire is made.

One Acre Fund never asks candidates to pay any money or pay for tests at any stage of the interview process. Official One Acre Fund emails will always arrive from an @oneacrefund.org address. Please report any suspicious communication here (globalhotline@oneacrefund.org), but do not send applications or application materials to this email address.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion (DEI), and anti-racism are deeply connected to our organization’s mission and purpose. One Acre Fund aspires to build a culture where all staff feel consistently valued, represented, and connected – so that our team can thrive as professionals, and achieve exceptional impact for the farmers we serve.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

ndangira.title_raw: Legal Officer at ECOFLEET SOLUTIONS Ltd : ( Deadline 05-10-2026)
ndangira.description:
ECOFLEET SOLUTIONS LTD JOB DESCRIPTION 

LEGAL OFFICER 

Job Title 
Legal Officer

Reports To 
Head of Legal & Company Secretary

Department 
Legal Department

Location 
Kigali, Rwanda

Job Type 
Full-time

1. ROLE SUMMARY 

The Legal Officer supports the Head of Legal & Company Secretary in providing sound legal advice, drafting and reviewing corporate documents, and managing legal risks to protect the commercial and regulatory interests of Ecofleet Solutions Ltd. 

2. SCOPE OF THE ROLE 

The role involves supporting corporate governance, contract management, regulatory compliance, and litigation processes. The Legal Officer works closely with internal departments and external counsel, reporting directly to the Head of Legal & Company Secretary. 

3. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

Draft, review, and negotiate commercial contracts, agreements, and MOUs. 

Provide legal opinions on labor law, commercial transactions, and intellectual property matters. 

Maintain statutory records and ensure timely corporate filings with RDB and relevant authorities. 

Coordinate with external counsel on litigation and represent the company in administrative proceedings where required. 

Review and update internal policies to ensure legal and regulatory compliance. 

Identify and mitigate legal risks across company operations. 

4. WORKING RELATIONSHIPS 

The Legal Officer maintains the following key working relationships:

Relationship 
Nature of Engagement

Head of Legal & Company Secretary
Direct reporting line; legal strategy and escalation of key legal matters.

Internal Departments 
Legal advisory support on contracts, transactions, and compliance matters.

External Counsel 
Coordination on litigation and specialised legal matters.

RDB & Regulatory Authorities
Corporate filings and regulatory compliance.

5. INDICATORS OF SUCCESS 

Legal documents reviewed and returned within 48-72 hours. 

Minimisation of legal exposure and successful out-of-court settlements. 

100% compliance with statutory filing deadlines. 

6. CORE COMPETENCIES & SKILLS 

Excellent legal drafting and negotiation skills. 

Fluent in English and Kinyarwanda; French is an added advantage. 

Strong interpersonal and presentation skills. 

7. VALUES & CULTURAL FIT 

High integrity and professionalism in legal practice. 

Sound judgement and attention to detail. 

Collaborative approach with internal departments and external counsel. 

Commitment to protecting Ecofleet's legal and commercial interests. 

8. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

Minimum: 

Bachelor of Laws (LL.B) and Diploma in Legal Practice (DLP). 

Minimum of 4 years of post-qualification legal experience in a corporate environment or law firm.

Preferred: 

Experience in logistics, transport, or fleet management sectors is an advantage.

How to Apply

Applicants should submit their application by email to careers@ecofleet.rw.

Applications should be compiled into one folder or file clearly labeled with the position applied for and must include:

A cover letter addressed to Aubin RUKERA, Chief Executive Officer, Ecofleet Solutions Ltd

A detailed Curriculum Vitae

Certified copies of academic and professional certificates

Reports To 
Chief Digital & Experience Officer (CDXO)

Department 
Digital & Experience

Location 
Kigali, Rwanda

Job Type 
Full-time

1. ROLE SUMMARY 

The Digital Innovation & Analytics Officer drives data-driven decision-making and innovation across Ecofleet's operations and digital ecosystem. Reporting to the CDXO, the role focuses on transforming data into actionable insights, identifying opportunities for innovation, and supporting the continuous improvement of services, systems, and customer experience. The Officer plays a central role in analytics, reporting, and digital innovation, working across departments to unlock value from data and support strategic and operational performance. 

2. SCOPE OF THE ROLE 

The Digital Innovation & Analytics Officer develops and manages data analytics frameworks and reporting systems, analyzes operational, financial, and digital data to generate insights, and identifies and supports the implementation of digital innovation initiatives. The role builds dashboards and visualization tools for decision-making, supports predictive analytics and performance optimization efforts, and promotes a data-driven culture across the organization. 

3. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

Collect, clean, and analyze data from multiple sources (FMS, finance systems, digital platforms, operations). 

Develop and maintain dashboards and reports for operational and executive use. 

Identify trends, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities across fleet operations and customer experience. 

Support development of predictive models (e.g., demand forecasting, maintenance planning, route optimization). 

Collaborate with the M&E Officer to align KPI tracking and reporting frameworks. 

Work with the FMS Product Officer and Platform & UX Officer to enhance data availability and usability. 

Explore and recommend innovative digital solutions (automation, AI, data tools) to improve performance. 

Support pilot projects and innovation initiatives with data analysis and evaluation.

Ensure data quality, consistency, and governance across systems. 

Present insights and recommendations to leadership in a clear and actionable manner. 

4.WORKING RELATIONSHIPS 

The Digital Innovation & Analytics Officer maintains the following key working relationships: 

Relationship 
Nature of Engagement

CDXO 
Strategic direction on analytics and innovation priorities.

FMS Product Officer 
Access to fleet data and system-based insights.

Platform & UX Officer 
User behavior analytics and experience optimization.

Enterprise IT & Cybersecurity Officer
Data infrastructure, security, and governance.

M&E Officer 
Alignment of KPIs, reporting standards, and performance frameworks.

COO 
Operational insights and performance optimization.

CFO 
Financial analytics and cost optimization.

CSEO 
Sustainability metrics and environmental performance tracking.

Data & Analytics Solution Providers
Tools, platforms, and technical support.

Consultants, Research & Innovation Partners
Support on analytics and innovation initiatives.

Availability of accurate, timely, and actionable analytics dashboards. 

Increased use of data in operational and strategic decision-making. 

Measurable improvements driven by data insights (efficiency, cost savings, service quality). 

Successful implementation of innovation initiatives and pilots. 

Strong alignment between analytics outputs and business needs. 

Improved data quality and consistency across systems. 

6. CORE COMPETENCIES & SKILLS 

Strong analytical and data interpretation skills. 

Proficiency in data tools (Excel, Power BI, SQL, or similar). 

Understanding of data modeling, visualization, and reporting. 

Ability to translate data into actionable insights. 

Curiosity and innovation mindset.

Strong communication and presentation skills. 

Attention to detail and data accuracy. 

7. VALUES & CULTURAL FIT 

Data-driven mindset and commitment to evidence-based decisions. 

Curiosity and continuous improvement. 

Collaboration across departments. 

Accountability and ownership of insights and outcomes. 

Passion for innovation in mobility and public service. 

8. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

Minimum: 

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field. 

3-5 years' experience in data analysis, analytics, or digital innovation roles. 

Preferred: 

Experience in transport, logistics, energy, or infrastructure sectors. 

Strong skills in Power BI, SQL, Python, or similar tools. 

Experience with predictive analytics or machine learning (basic to intermediate). 

Experience working with cross-functional teams and executive stakeholders. 

Exposure to digital transformation or innovation projects.

How to Apply

Applicants should submit their application by email to careers@ecofleet.rw.

Applications should be compiled into one folder or file clearly labeled with the position applied for and must include:

A cover letter addressed to Aubin RUKERA, Chief Executive Officer, Ecofleet Solutions Ltd

A detailed Curriculum Vitae

Certified copies of academic and professional certificates

ndangira.title: Associate, Data Science at CHAI - The Clinton Health Access Initiative, Inc.
ndangira.title_raw: Associate, Data Science at CHAI - The Clinton Health Access Initiative, Inc.: (Deadline  12 October  2027)
ndangira.description:
Job Description

The Clinton Health Access Initiative, Inc. (CHAI) is a global health organization committed to our mission of saving lives and reducing the burden of disease in low-and middle-income countries. We work at the invitation of governments to support them and the private sector to create and sustain high-quality health systems.

CHAI was founded in 2002 in response to the HIV/AIDS epidemic, with the goal of dramatically reducing the price of life-saving drugs and increasing access to these medicines in the countries with the highest burden of the disease. Over the following two decades, CHAI has expanded its focus. Today, along with HIV, we work with our partners to prevent and treat infectious diseases such as COVID-19, malaria, tuberculosis, and hepatitis. Our work has also expanded into cancer, diabetes, hypertension, and other non-communicable diseases, and we work to accelerate the rollout of lifesaving vaccines, reduce maternal and child mortality, combat chronic malnutrition, and increase access to assistive technology. We are investing in horizontal approaches to strengthen health systems through programs in human resources for health, digital health, and health financing. With each new and innovative program, our strategy is grounded in maximizing sustainable impact at scale, ensuring that governments lead the solutions, that programs are designed to scale nationally, and learnings are shared globally.

At CHAI, our people are our greatest asset, and none of this work would be possible without their talent, time, dedication, and passion for our mission and values. We are a highly diverse team of enthusiastic individuals across 40 countries with a broad range of skill sets and life experiences. CHAI is deeply grounded in the countries we work in, with the majority of our staff based in program countries. Learn more about our exciting work: http://www.clintonhealthaccess.org

CHAI is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and is committed to providing an environment of fairness, and mutual respect where all applicants have access to equal employment opportunities. CHAI values diversity and inclusion and recognizes that our mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people with diverse experience, backgrounds, and culture.

Program Overview

The Government of Rwanda (GoR) strives to achieve Universal Health Coverage (UHC) by enabling equitable access to quality health services for the population as outlined in the Fourth Health Sector Strategic Plan (HSSP IV). This commitment has been made against a backdrop of rising health care costs and uncertainty around the future availability of donor funding and calls for improved health sector sustainability. Acknowledging this, the Government aims to employ effective, equitable, efficient, and sustainable health care financing and systems strengthening, emphasizing primary health care as the cornerstone of a strong and sustainable health system.

CHAI Rwanda’s Health System Strengthening (HSS) programs work on a day-to-day basis with Government leadership in the Ministry of Health (MoH) and the Rwanda Social Security Board (RSSB). The goal of those programs is to support the Government to accelerate progress towards UHC by ensuring the sustainable delivery of quality, essential health services. This includes designing and implementing national Primary Health Care (PHC) reforms from health centre level down to community health, to increase health workforce availability, to prioritize and sustainably finance essential services. It also aims to support improved management, financing, and delivery of quality primary health care.

Position Overview

CHAI currently seeks an Associate, Data Science to work with the Ministry of Health (MOH), reporting directly to the head of data science at the National Health Intelligence Centre to help improve the quality, governance, and use of evidence on policy decision-making. S/He also reports in parallel to CHAI, HSS digital health program manager for specific CHAI supported initiatives.

The Associate, Data Science is responsible for leading advanced data analytics, statistical modelling, and applied machine learning across priority public health and clinical domains. The role ensures that health data is transformed into high-quality, reliable, explainable, and decision-ready intelligence that informs AI development, policy decisions, and health system's performance improvement. This role serves as the technical bridge between raw health data, AI models, and real-world decision-making, ensuring scientific rigour, reproducibility, and national-scale usability.

This is a top government priority for MOH, and the Associate, Data Scientist will therefore be seconded to the MOH/NHIC, S/He also reports in parallel to CHAI, HSS digital health program manager for specific CHAI-supported initiatives.

Responsibilities

Advanced Data Analytics and Statistical Modelling

Lead advanced descriptive, predictive, and inferential analyses across clinical, surveillance, and health systems datasets.

Develop and validate predictive models, risk stratification algorithms, forecasting models, epidemiological and operational analytics.

Apply rigorous statistical methods, hypothesis testing, and causal inference techniques to support decision-making.

Ensure all analytics are clinically interpretable, policy-relevant, and scientifically defensible.

Feature Engineering & Machine Learning Support

Design robust feature engineering pipelines from EMRs, HMIS, LMIS and surveillance platforms.

Support AI Engineers with high-quality training datasets, feature selection, bias detection and data representativeness testing.

Contribute to development of machine learning models, particularly in tabular health data, time-series forecasting and population-level risk prediction.

Data Quality, Governance, and Integrity

Lead implementation of data quality frameworks, completeness, consistency, accuracy, and timeliness checks.

Perform data audits, outlier detection, bias and missing data analysis.

Ensure compliance with national health data governance standards, privacy and ethical data use policies.

Maintain full data documentation, metadata standards, and lineage tracking.

Health Systems Intelligence & Decision Support

Develop decision-support analytics and public health dashboards for disease burden tracking, resource allocation and service delivery optimization.

Translate analytical outputs into policy briefs, executive dashboards, technical report.

Ensure outputs are actionable, explainable, and aligned with the national health priorities.

Data Engineering Support and Pipeline Optimization

Work closely with Data engineers, integration teams and AI engineers to ensure analytics assets are scalable, reproducible and production ready.

Support data pipeline optimization, ETL quality validation and real-time and batch processing readiness.

Mentorship, Capacity Building & Collaboration

Mentor junior data scientists and analysts.

Lead internal analytics communities of practice, code reviews and methodology workshops.

Serve as a technical reviewer for analytics protocols, research designs and data science deliverables.

Innovation and Continuous Improvement

Stay current with advances in Machine Learning, Statistical Science, Health Analytics, Artificial Intelligence and Causal Inference trends.

Propose innovative analytics and data science use cases for public health, service delivery, health financing, supply chain and logistics for pharmaceuticals and disease surveillance.

Qualifications

M.Sc. degree in relevant discipline (Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Operations Research, Statistics, Epidemiology, Health Informatics).

5–8 years of professional experience in the field of advanced analytics and/or applied statistics preferably with Data Science applications.

Solid mathematical foundation and knowledge of various statistical methods (e.g. regression, classification, clustering, experimental design, modelling, advanced forecasting).

Proven experience working with large-scale datasets, regulated data environments, preferably within a health domain.

Strong proficiency in data visualization, demonstrated experience in Python, R, SQL, and working with structured, semi-structured and unstructured datasets.

Ability to focus on vaguely defined problems requiring the application of a creative approach.

Strong teamwork skills.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills for coordinating across teams.

Ability to mentor and lead teams in a fast-paced and changing environment.

Application Procedure

After submitting your CV (maximum 3 pages) through this link, please email a letter of interest (maximum 1 page) outlining how your background meets the requirements outlined above to chairwandarecruiting@clintonhealthaccess.org with " Associate, Data Scientist " in the subject line.

The deadline for applications is October 12, 2026. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

In compliance with the data protection law of Rwanda and by submitting your application and CV, you explicitly consent to the collection, processing, and storage of your personal data by Clinton Health Access Initiative for the sole purpose of managing and conducting the recruitment process for the position for which you have applied.

CLICK HERE TO READ MORE AND APPLY

Job Description

The Clinton Health Access Initiative, Inc. (CHAI) is a global health organization committed to our mission of saving lives and reducing the burden of disease in low-and middle-income countries. We work at the invitation of governments to support them and the private sector to create and sustain high-quality health systems.

CHAI was founded in 2002 in response to the HIV/AIDS epidemic, with the goal of dramatically reducing the price of life-saving drugs and increasing access to these medicines in the countries with the highest burden of the disease. Over the following two decades, CHAI has expanded its focus. Today, along with HIV, we work with our partners to prevent and treat infectious diseases such as COVID-19, malaria, tuberculosis, and hepatitis. Our work has also expanded into cancer, diabetes, hypertension, and other non-communicable diseases, and we work to accelerate the rollout of lifesaving vaccines, reduce maternal and child mortality, combat chronic malnutrition, and increase access to assistive technology. We are investing in horizontal approaches to strengthen health systems through programs in human resources for health, digital health, and health financing. With each new and innovative program, our strategy is grounded in maximizing sustainable impact at scale, ensuring that governments lead the solutions, that programs are designed to scale nationally, and learnings are shared globally.

At CHAI, our people are our greatest asset, and none of this work would be possible without their talent, time, dedication, and passion for our mission and values. We are a highly diverse team of enthusiastic individuals across 40 countries with a broad range of skill sets and life experiences. CHAI is deeply grounded in the countries we work in, with the majority of our staff based in program countries. Learn more about our exciting work: http://www.clintonhealthaccess.org

CHAI is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and is committed to providing an environment of fairness, and mutual respect where all applicants have access to equal employment opportunities. CHAI values diversity and inclusion and recognizes that our mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people with diverse experience, backgrounds, and culture.

Program Overview

The Government of Rwanda (GoR) strives to achieve Universal Health Coverage (UHC) by enabling equitable access to quality health services for the population as outlined in the Fourth Health Sector Strategic Plan (HSSP IV). This commitment has been made against a backdrop of rising health care costs and uncertainty around the future availability of donor funding and calls for improved health sector sustainability. Acknowledging this, the Government aims to employ effective, equitable, efficient, and sustainable health care financing and systems strengthening, emphasizing primary health care as the cornerstone of a strong and sustainable health system.

CHAI Rwanda’s Health System Strengthening (HSS) programs work on a day-to-day basis with Government leadership in the Ministry of Health (MoH) and the Rwanda Social Security Board (RSSB). The goal of those programs is to support the Government to accelerate progress towards UHC by ensuring the sustainable delivery of quality, essential health services. This includes designing and implementing national Primary Health Care (PHC) reforms from health centre level down to community health, to increase health workforce availability, to prioritize and sustainably finance essential services. It also aims to support improved management, financing, and delivery of quality primary health care.

Position Overview

CHAI currently seeks an Associate, Data Science to work with the Ministry of Health (MOH), reporting directly to the head of data science at the National Health Intelligence Centre to help improve the quality, governance, and use of evidence on policy decision-making. S/He also reports in parallel to CHAI, HSS digital health program manager for specific CHAI supported initiatives.

The Associate, Data Science is responsible for leading advanced data analytics, statistical modelling, and applied machine learning across priority public health and clinical domains. The role ensures that health data is transformed into high-quality, reliable, explainable, and decision-ready intelligence that informs AI development, policy decisions, and health system's performance improvement. This role serves as the technical bridge between raw health data, AI models, and real-world decision-making, ensuring scientific rigour, reproducibility, and national-scale usability.

This is a top government priority for MOH, and the Associate, Data Scientist will therefore be seconded to the MOH/NHIC, S/He also reports in parallel to CHAI, HSS digital health program manager for specific CHAI-supported initiatives.

Responsibilities

Advanced Data Analytics and Statistical Modelling

Lead advanced descriptive, predictive, and inferential analyses across clinical, surveillance, and health systems datasets.

Develop and validate predictive models, risk stratification algorithms, forecasting models, epidemiological and operational analytics.

Apply rigorous statistical methods, hypothesis testing, and causal inference techniques to support decision-making.

Ensure all analytics are clinically interpretable, policy-relevant, and scientifically defensible.

Feature Engineering & Machine Learning Support

Design robust feature engineering pipelines from EMRs, HMIS, LMIS and surveillance platforms.

Support AI Engineers with high-quality training datasets, feature selection, bias detection and data representativeness testing.

Contribute to development of machine learning models, particularly in tabular health data, time-series forecasting and population-level risk prediction.

Data Quality, Governance, and Integrity

Lead implementation of data quality frameworks, completeness, consistency, accuracy, and timeliness checks.

Perform data audits, outlier detection, bias and missing data analysis.

Ensure compliance with national health data governance standards, privacy and ethical data use policies.

Maintain full data documentation, metadata standards, and lineage tracking.

Health Systems Intelligence & Decision Support

Develop decision-support analytics and public health dashboards for disease burden tracking, resource allocation and service delivery optimization.

Translate analytical outputs into policy briefs, executive dashboards, technical report.

Ensure outputs are actionable, explainable, and aligned with the national health priorities.

Data Engineering Support and Pipeline Optimization

Work closely with Data engineers, integration teams and AI engineers to ensure analytics assets are scalable, reproducible and production ready.

Support data pipeline optimization, ETL quality validation and real-time and batch processing readiness.

Mentorship, Capacity Building & Collaboration

Mentor junior data scientists and analysts.

Lead internal analytics communities of practice, code reviews and methodology workshops.

Serve as a technical reviewer for analytics protocols, research designs and data science deliverables.

Innovation and Continuous Improvement

Stay current with advances in Machine Learning, Statistical Science, Health Analytics, Artificial Intelligence and Causal Inference trends.

Propose innovative analytics and data science use cases for public health, service delivery, health financing, supply chain and logistics for pharmaceuticals and disease surveillance.

Qualifications

M.Sc. degree in relevant discipline (Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Actuarial Science, Operations Research, Statistics, Epidemiology, Health Informatics).

5–8 years of professional experience in the field of advanced analytics and/or applied statistics preferably with Data Science applications.

Solid mathematical foundation and knowledge of various statistical methods (e.g. regression, classification, clustering, experimental design, modelling, advanced forecasting).

Proven experience working with large-scale datasets, regulated data environments, preferably within a health domain.

Strong proficiency in data visualization, demonstrated experience in Python, R, SQL, and working with structured, semi-structured and unstructured datasets.

Ability to focus on vaguely defined problems requiring the application of a creative approach.

Strong teamwork skills.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills for coordinating across teams.

Ability to mentor and lead teams in a fast-paced and changing environment.

Application Procedure

After submitting your CV (maximum 3 pages) through this link, please email a letter of interest (maximum 1 page) outlining how your background meets the requirements outlined above to chairwandarecruiting@clintonhealthaccess.org with " Associate, Data Scientist " in the subject line.

The deadline for applications is October 12, 2026. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

ndangira.description:
Career Opportunities: Head of Programmes (54963)

The Organisation

Plan International is an independent development and humanitarian organisation that advances children’s rights and equality for girls. We believe in the power and potential of every child but know this is often suppressed by poverty, violence, exclusion and discrimination. And it is girls who are most affected.

Working together with children, young people, supporters and partners, we strive for a just world, tackling the root causes of the challenges girls and vulnerable children face. We support children’s rights from birth until they reach adulthood and we enable children to prepare for and respond to crises and adversity. We drive changes in practice and policy at local, national and global levels using our reach, experience and knowledge.

For over 85 years, we have rallied other determined optimists to transform the lives of all children in more than 80 countries.

We won’t stop until we are all equal.

ROLE PURPOSE

Plan International is an independent development and humanitarian organisation that advances children’s rights and equality for girls. We believe in the power and potential of every child but know this is often suppressed by poverty, violence, exclusion and discrimination. And it is girls who are most affected.

Working together with children, young people, supporters and partners, we strive for a just world, tackling the root causes of the challenges girls and vulnerable children face. We support children’s rights from birth until they reach adulthood and we enable children to prepare for and respond to crises and adversity. We drive changes in practice and policy at local, national and global levels using our reach, experience and knowledge. We won’t stop until we are all equal.

The Head of Programmes is responsible for leading and providing strategic leadership and operational oversight for designing, implementing and evaluating quality gender transformative programmes and influencing that are consistent with the Country Strategy of Plan International Rwanda and Plan International standards, priorities and principles for advancing children and youth’s rights and equality for girls.

As a staff member of a child-centred international development and humanitarian organisation, the Head of Programmes will commit to complying with Plan International’s standards and policies related to Safeguarding and PSHEA (Preventing Sexual Harassment, Exploitation and Abuse), gender equality, inclusion and diversity. All Plan staff are expected to uphold the organisation's values and behaviours in every aspect of their work.

The Head of Programmes provides strategic leadership and operational oversight for all programmatic aspects of the country office. S/He is responsible for developing and executing programmes aligned with the country office strategy, ensuring high-quality, gender-transformative projects that advance children and youth’s rights, with a focus on girls' equality. S/He works closely with Programme Managers, Project Managers, and Programme Unit Managers to oversee project design, planning, implementation, monitoring, risk and budget management, and project closure, all within the framework of the Country Strategy and Plan International standards of project management and of management standards.

As a strategic member of the Country Management Team, the Head of Programme provides strategic vision on the implementation of the Country strategy but also supports the Country Office through its technical advisers in fundraising, through positioning and supporting the development of strong quality proposals.

S/He also plays a crucial role in integrating safeguarding policies into programmatic work, ensuring that all activities are carried out with the highest standards of safety and protection for children and youth.

By fostering collaboration, driving continuous learning, and influencing positive change, the Head of Programmes plays a pivotal role in shaping impactful, sustainable programmes that transform the lives of children, girls and young people across the country.

To view the Job description click here: Head of Programmes_JD.pdf

Location: Country Office-Kigali

Type of Role: Head of Programmes (For Rwandan National Only) 

Reports to: Country Director

Grade: Level 18

Closing Date: 30/09/2026

Equality, diversity and inclusion is at the very heart of everything that Plan International stands for.

We want Plan International to reflect the diversity of the communities we work with, offering equal opportunities to everyone regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation.

Plan International is based on a culture of inclusivity and we strive to create a workplace environment that ensures every team, in every office, in every country, is rich in diverse people, thoughts, and ideas.

We foster an organisational culture that embraces our commitment to racial justice, gender equality, girls’ rights and inclusion.

Plan International believes that in a world where children face so many threats of harm, it is our duty to ensure that we, as an organisation, do everything we can to keep children safe. This means that we have particular responsibilities to children that we come into contact with and we must not contribute in any way to harming or placing children at risk.

A range of pre-employment checks will be undertaken in conformity with Plan International's Safeguarding Children and Young People policy. Plan International also participates in the Inter Agency Misconduct Disclosure Scheme. In line with this scheme we will request information from applicants previous employers about any findings of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse and/or sexual harassment during employment, or incidents under investigation when the applicant left employment. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms their understanding of these recruitment procedures.

Please note that Plan International will never send unsolicited emails requesting payment from candidates. 

CLICK HERE TO READ MORE AND APPLY

4 Job Positions at Wicloud: (Deadline 16-10-2026)

IT LEAD JD

COMPANY INTRODUCTION

Wicloudrwd is a global digital transformation and IT outsourcing company established in 2022, with operations across multiple international locations. The company provides technology and IT outsourcing solutions tailored to Microsoft environments, with expertise across Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Windows Commercial, and Microsoft Office 365.

Location: Kigali, Rwanda
Employment Type: Full-time
Working Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced IT Lead to oversee IT operations, infrastructure, security, compliance, team development, and technology innovation for Wicloudrwd's Kigali operations.

The successful candidate will provide strong technical and operational leadership, establish effective IT processes and controls, and ensure that IT services meet business and client requirements.

Key Responsibilities

1. IT Operations & Governance

Oversee end-to-end IT operations in Kigali.

Establish clear IT governance, roles, responsibilities, and escalation mechanisms.

Ensure timely incident reporting, coordination, and resolution for major IT issues.

Provide regular IT status, risk, and improvement reports to management.

2. Infrastructure & Service Management

Manage corporate networks (LAN/WAN/VPN), servers, cloud resources, endpoints, and collaboration tools.

Ensure office and production environments meet business SLA requirements.

Own the IT asset lifecycle, including procurement, deployment, inventory, and retirement.

Manage external vendors and service providers.

3. Information Security & Compliance

Implement and maintain IT security and compliance controls required for business lines.

Support internal audits, customer reviews, and compliance assessments.

Define and enforce IT security policies, incident response plans, and awareness programs.

Ensure appropriate access control, identity management, and data protection.

4. AI Enablement & Innovation

Identify and implement AI solutions to enhance IT operations and productivity.

Drive adoption of AI tools to optimize internal workflows and service delivery.

Collaborate with stakeholders to integrate AI into support and business processes.

5. Team Leadership & Development

Lead and manage IT teams across multiple offices.

Set clear performance objectives and accountability mechanisms.

Improve execution, professionalism, and internal service credibility of the IT function.

Build standardized processes to reduce dependency on individuals.

6. Cross-functional & International Communication

Work closely with business, compliance, security, operations, and other functional teams.

Communicate effectively in English with overseas leadership teams.

Translate technical issues into structured, business-oriented updates for non-technical stakeholders.

Qualifications & Requirements

Required

Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

6+ years of IT experience, including 2–3 years in an IT Lead or equivalent role.

Hands-on experience in IT infrastructure and operations, with solid knowledge of ITSM and security compliance.

Practical experience applying AI in operations and/or productivity.

Technical & Professional Skills

Proven experience managing IT for multi-site or mid-to-large organizations is a plus.

Solid foundation in networking, systems, and enterprise IT environments.

Familiarity with ITSM processes, including Incident, Problem, and Change Management.

Hands-on experience with information security and compliance in international service environments.

Cloud platform experience, such as Microsoft Azure, is a strong advantage.

Leadership & Personal Attributes

Strong ownership mindset and risk awareness.

Proactive, structured, and execution-driven.

Able to lead teams with authority and credibility.

Comfortable working under high standards and client scrutiny.

AI-related Experience

Experience with one or more of the following is expected:

Generative AI and LLM tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot, or Gemini.

Prompt engineering.

AI automation for operations.

AI chatbot implementation.

AI knowledge base development.

AI-enabled process automation.

AI for ticket triage in support environments.

AI workflow optimization.

AI-driven reporting.

Language Requirements

Local Language: Fluent in reading, writing, and speaking.

English: Strong professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

Application Process

Interested and qualified candidates can send their CV to Francis@itechwx.com in the format 'Role+Application+ their name'.

WINDOWS FORUM FREELANCER JD

COMPANY INTRODUCTION

Wicloudrwd is a global digital transformation and IT outsourcing company established in 2022, with operations across multiple international locations. The company provides technology and IT outsourcing solutions tailored to Microsoft environments, with expertise across Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Windows Commercial, and Microsoft Office 365.

Location: Rwanda
Employment Type: Freelancer

About the Role

We are seeking motivated freelancers to join the Windows Community Forum team on Microsoft Learn. As a freelancer, you will play a vital role in supporting users worldwide by managing community threads, providing accurate solutions, and ensuring a positive experience for all members.

This is a flexible opportunity for individuals who want to develop their technical expertise while earning income through community support activities.

Key Responsibilities

1. Community Thread Management

Review and respond to user questions in the Windows Community Forum.

Monitor assigned community threads and ensure questions receive appropriate attention.

Maintain a professional, respectful, and helpful interaction with community members.

2. Technical Support & Problem Resolution

Research user issues using approved knowledge bases and training materials.

Provide clear, accurate, and solution-oriented responses.

Help users understand available solutions and relevant Microsoft resources.

3. Escalation & Follow-up

Escalate unresolved or advanced cases for senior support or moderator review.

Follow up where appropriate to ensure community members receive adequate support.

Identify issues that require additional technical investigation.

4. Compliance & Confidentiality

Protect user information and maintain confidentiality.

Follow community guidelines, approved processes, and training materials.

Adhere to applicable Microsoft community standards and Code of Conduct requirements.

Qualifications & Requirements

Strong written communication skills with a professional, respectful, and empathetic tone.

Ability to follow community guidelines, procedures, and training materials closely.

Technical knowledge of Windows and Microsoft products is preferred.

Experience in online support, customer service, community moderation, or technical troubleshooting is an advantage.

Strong attention to accuracy and detail.

Ability to research technical issues and communicate solutions clearly.

Commitment to confidentiality and solution-oriented customer support.

Training & Tools

Training and supporting resources will be provided, including:

Community guidelines and etiquette training.

Access to knowledge base documents, FAQs, and troubleshooting guides.

Hands-on practice with the IXPT Tool for thread management.

Simulated practice threads before handling live cases.

Benefits

Flexible, remote work opportunities.

Access to Microsoft Learn resources and training.

Opportunity to grow technical expertise and reputation in the community.

Monthly income is based on contributions.

Application Process

Interested and qualified candidates can send their CV to Francis@itechwx.com in the format 'Role+Application+ their name'.

TECHNICAL SUPPORT ENGINEER

COMPANY INTRODUCTION

Wicloudrwd is a global digital transformation and IT outsourcing company established in 2022, with operations across multiple international locations. Location: Kigali, Rwanda
Employment Type: Full-time
Working Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM

About the Role

We are seeking a hands-on Finance Lead to independently manage the Company's routine accounting, tax compliance, payroll, project costing, and local finance administration.

The Finance Lead will work closely with the Kigali team and HQ Finance & Operations functions to ensure accurate financial reporting, strong financial controls, and compliance with applicable Rwanda requirements.

The successful candidate must be able to independently perform core finance activities and possess a sound academic and professional understanding of more complex financial and tax concepts.

Key Responsibilities

1. Accounting & Financial Reporting

Independently manage full-cycle accounting, including:

Journal entries.

Accounts payable and receivable.

Accruals and bank reconciliations.

Fixed asset records and depreciation.

Manage month-end closing and preparation of monthly financial reports.

Maintain accurate accounting records and supporting documentation.

Prepare schedules and information for management, audit, and statutory purposes.

2. Tax, Invoice & Payroll Compliance

Independently manage routine Rwanda finance and compliance matters, including:

VAT, PAYE, withholding tax, and other applicable statutory obligations.

Invoice and supporting document compliance.

Payroll records, statutory deductions, and employer contributions.
