About the Role:

The role of Technical Sector Officer - Livestock (TSO-Livestock) will deliver hands on assist to the Technical Specialist- Market Systems Development & Livelihood and Regional Manager to ensure all livelihood and market development activities, including implementation of livelihoods, market development and market facilitation activities, are effectively delivered and on time. This role will also deliver assist to create and contextualize asset-specific training modules; train frontline staff on the newly developed training materials; help create the detailed participant training rollout plans and assist the cascading down of the training. The role will also assist the operations team in budgeting, in ensuring quality procurement, asset distribution and asset management assist.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Technical Sector assist:

assist the planning and delivery of livelihood activities in livestock and poultry; including training, cash transfer for asset purchase by participants, recommend and help with the purchase of assets related to Goat and Pig rearing as well as poultry, facilitating linkages with market actors and service providers.

assist the planning and delivery of livelihood activities in agriculture and farming including training, cash transfer for asset purchase by participants, help with the purchase of assets related to farming activities, ensuring that participants and/or their guardians have enrolled in smart Nkunganire system, for inputs purchase with government subsidies, as well as using the required quantity and quality of inputs. Also, the position holder will help with asset follow-up, facilitating linkages with market actors and service providers.

deliver assist to the Technical Specialists for the development of specific livelihood pathways training modules, as needed.

assist the training of front-line staff on the newly developed training materials; finalize the participant training rollout plans and deliver logistics and planning assist to the cascading down of the training.

assist the budgeting, planning and delivery of all livestock and agriculture related livelihood interventions, including supporting localized market assessments; training on chosen livelihood pathways and entrepreneurship; asset mapping, procurement, distribution and management.

assist the facilitation of relevant linkages to TVET, apprenticeship and entrepreneurship.

assist the training of branch staff and ensure the participant's economic needs assessment/economic profiling and market assessments are done effectively prior to livelihood selection.

assist the selection and training of the Community Livestock and Agriculture Promoter and ensure they are ready to deliver service to participants.

Be informed of and compile a full list of national and districts laws and regulations (such as quarantine requirements for livestock and agriculture), disseminate this knowledge with field teams and ensure all livelihoods and market development interventions are developed in accordance with the existing laws and regulations.

Perform periodic evaluate of training modules and make necessary changes, as needed in joint collaboration with the Technical Specialist - MSDL.

assist the Technical Specialist – CM & GESI for to effectively integrate GESI considerations in program activities, including making accommodations for vulnerable groups such as PWDs, IDP, refugees, and other relevant underrepresented groups.

2. Coordination and Planning assist:

assist communication with key stakeholders (government and non-government) and collect relevant training materials that can be used to create/strengthen/ contextualize BRAC’s training materials.

assist coordination with a range of stakeholders, including government entities, INGOs, CSOs, YDC members, service providers, to assist delivery of interventions.

3. Reporting Support:

Regularly check MIS and ensure proper reporting, data accuracy and validation.

Safeguarding responsibilities:

Ensure the safety of team members from any harm, abuse, neglect, harassment and exploitation to achieve the programme’s goals on safeguarding implementation.

Act as a key source of assist, guidance and expertise on safeguarding for establishing a safe working environment.

Practice, promote and endorse the issues of safeguarding policy among team members and ensure the implementation of safeguarding standards in every course of action.

Follow the safeguarding reporting procedure in case any reportable incident takes place, encourage others to do so.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

Country-specific training manual development, clear training roll-out and staff capacity building plan

Timely and effective delivery of all livelihood and market development related activities

individual/specific KPIs as agreed with supervisor.

Academic Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Veterinary sciences, Veterinary Medicine, Animal production, Animal Husbandry, Veterinary sciences, Veterinary Medicine, Animal production, Animal Husbandry or any other related.

Required Skills, Competencies & Knowledge:

Training materials development and staff capacity development

Computer literacy

Report writing

Experience Requirements:

3 years of relevant experience, preferring in programs focused on the Agriculture sector, livelihoods or economic development in an NGO or other humanitarian environment.

1 year of experience in implementing activities related to socio-economic empowerment for young women would be an added value.

Previous experience in providing technical assistance, especially related to livelihood or economic empowerment related activities, training module development, and training facilitation

Previous experience working in integrated programs targeted for women is a plus.

Employment type: Regular/Fixed-Term

About BRAC International:

BRAC International (BI), a leading non-profit organization, is on a mission to empower people and communities facing poverty, illiteracy, disease, and social injustice. Our vision is to create a world free from exploitation and discrimination, where everyone has the opportunity to realize their potential. We design proven, scalable solutions that equip people with the assist and confidence they need to achieve their potential.

BRAC was founded in Bangladesh in 1972 and over the last five decades has grown to become one of the world’s largest non-governmental organisations (NGOs), reaching over 100 million people. We started our first international operation by venturing into Afghanistan in 2002, building on lessons from our work in Bangladesh to assist a nation devastated by war. Currently operating in 16 countries across Asia and Africa. Born, proven and led in the Global South, BRAC International brings a unique Southern perspective and commitment to continuous learning, providing a depth of insight, experience and evidence to meet the needs of diverse communities with humility and courage across Asia and Africa. To learn more about BRAC International, please visit (www.bracinternational.org)

Our Core Values:

Integrity: We approach our collaborate with honesty and integrity.

Innovation: We innovate and iterate to enhance our impact.

Inclusiveness: We foster inclusion to reach those who need it most.

Effectiveness: We strive for effectiveness to better serve people in poverty.

About This Opportunity

The position of Officer, Branch Accounts & Administration at BRAC located in Branch Offices in Muhanga, Ruhango, Nyanza, Huye, Nyamagabe & Nyaruguru, Rwanda offers an opportunity for qualified professionals to contribute their knowledge and experience in a dynamic working environment. The organization seeks individuals who are motivated, reliable, and capable of performing their duties effectively while maintaining professional standards.

BRAC International is Hiring! Join BRAC International to create opportunities for people to realise their potential.

Position: Officer, Branch Accounts & Administration

Job Location: Branch Offices in Muhanga, Ruhango, Nyanza, Huye, Nyamagabe & Nyaruguru Districts

About the Role:

The Officer, Branch Accounts & Administration, reporting to the Branch Manager (BM) with dotted reporting to Assistant Regional Accounts Manager, s/he will oversee direct branch-level accounts and finance, procurement, coordination, partnership, and administrative staff in the branch (if any), help with overall programme implementation and other assigned activities. This will include day-to-day finance management and implementation, staff-capacity development, financial monitoring, and stakeholder management. She will assist the BM to ensure effective and timely program implementation and quality assurance. The Officer, Branch Accounts & Administration will also be tasked with overall finance reporting, banking, cash requisition, reporting (MIS, internal, and donor reporting) and supporting other technical and operational activities at the branch level.

Key Duties/Responsibilities:

The Officer, Branch Accounts & Administration will be responsible with the following:

Finance and Accounts Related Activities:

Record all Mobile Money deposits by updating the daily register and filling in all relevant vouchers and receipts with the necessary approvals, and ensure they are properly preserved.

Each morning, evaluate with the BM and other POs to determine the day’s expected Mobile Money inflows and plan for proper reconciliation

Share the collection sheets with the relevant POs based on the collection schedule (using VSLA platform) printed collection sheets.

Synchronize collections made by PAs with the accounting system, ensuring accuracy of both the collections and corresponding accounting records.

Submit the cash requisition with the signature of the BM to the regional accounts officer based on the approved activity plan. 

At the end of each business day and month-end, perform required cash reconciliation and check the collection ledger and DCR.

Ensure cash transfer under the Education Pathway.

Track and keep sufficient cash flow for smooth day-to-day project activities based on the country policy.

Record all branch-level expenses and financial transactions in the accounting system promptly to ensure accurate and timely month-end closing.

Serve as custodian of all financial and procurement documents, records, and information at the branch level, ensuring they are well-organized for research, monitoring, supervision, and audit purposes.

Branch Operations assist:

Occasionally visit AIM clubs, attend YDC meetings, VSLA meetings, and follow up on ongoing different field-level trainings. Livelihood & education participants etc.

help with the mentors’ recruitment process

help with club space identification and completion of the agreement, club operations, participants' invitation according to the programme operations manual. 

help with service provider mapping and establishment of working relationships. 

help with identification of school(s) to deliver education assist as per the programme design. 

Help to ensure timely disbursement of livelihood and education pathways assist to the participants. 

Custody of all branch-level electronic devices and furniture and keep stock register.

Act as the technical focal point at the branch level to ensure the use of Binsight and other digital tools.

Safeguarding Responsibilities:

Ensure the safety of team members from any harm, abuse, neglect, harassment and exploitation to achieve the project goals on safeguarding implementation.

Act as a key source of assist, guidance and expertise on safeguarding for establishing a safe working environment.

Practice, promote and endorse the issues of safeguarding policy among team members and ensure the implementation of safeguarding standards in every course of action.

Follow the safeguarding reporting procedure in case any reportable incident takes place, encourage others to do so

Academic Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Finance/Accounts/Business Administration/ Commerce and /or other relevant fields.

Required Skills, Competencies & Knowledge:

Experience in project management and coordination, including supervision and monitoring, administration, finance, and logistics 

Strong Microsoft Office skills

Strong sense of teamwork and collaboration, and demonstrated ability to build relationships with individuals from diverse backgrounds

Personal qualities of integrity, credibility, and dedication to the mission of BRAC.

Experience Required:

At least 2 years’ experience in national/international development sector, including experience with managing finance and accounts for development programs including microfinance, livelihood, education, agricultural and food security, and/or girl’s and women’s empowerment programs.

About BRAC

BRAC is the world’s largest, and leading development organization dedicated to poverty alleviation and empowerment of the poor. Initiated in Bangladesh in 1972, BRAC now operates in 11 countries acr...

About This Opportunity

The position of Officer, Branch Accounts & Administration at BRAC located in Branch Offices in Muhanga, Ruhango, Nyanza, Huye, Nyamagabe & Nyaruguru, Rwanda offers an opportunity for qualified professionals to contribute their knowledge and experience in a dynamic working environment. The organization seeks individuals who are motivated, reliable, and capable of performing their duties effectively while maintaining professional standards.

BRAC International is Hiring! Join BRAC International to create opportunities for people to realise their potential.

Position: Officer, Branch Accounts & Administration

Job Location: Branch Offices in Muhanga, Ruhango, Nyanza, Huye, Nyamagabe & Nyaruguru Districts

About the Role:

The Officer, Branch Accounts & Administration, reporting to the Branch Manager (BM) with dotted reporting to Assistant Regional Accounts Manager, s/he will oversee direct branch-level accounts and finance, procurement, coordination, partnership, and administrative staff in the branch (if any), help with overall programme implementation and other assigned activities. This will include day-to-day finance management and implementation, staff-capacity development, financial monitoring, and stakeholder management. She will assist the BM to ensure effective and timely program implementation and quality assurance. The Officer, Branch Accounts & Administration will also be tasked with overall finance reporting, banking, cash requisition, reporting (MIS, internal, and donor reporting) and supporting other technical and operational activities at the branch level.

Key Duties/Responsibilities:

The Officer, Branch Accounts & Administration will be responsible with the following:

Finance and Accounts Related Activities:

  • Record all Mobile Money deposits by updating the daily register and filling in all relevant vouchers and receipts with the necessary approvals, and ensure they are properly preserved.
  • Each morning, evaluate with the BM and other POs to determine the day’s expected Mobile Money inflows and plan for proper reconciliation
  • Share the collection sheets with the relevant POs based on the collection schedule (using VSLA platform) printed collection sheets.
  • Synchronize collections made by PAs with the accounting system, ensuring accuracy of both the collections and corresponding accounting records.
  • Submit the cash requisition with the signature of the BM to the regional accounts officer based on the approved activity plan.
  • At the end of each business day and month-end, perform required cash reconciliation and check the collection ledger and DCR.
  • Ensure cash transfer under the Education Pathway.
  • Track and keep sufficient cash flow for smooth day-to-day project activities based on the country policy.
  • Record all branch-level expenses and financial transactions in the accounting system promptly to ensure accurate and timely month-end closing.
  • Serve as custodian of all financial and procurement documents, records, and information at the branch level, ensuring they are well-organized for research, monitoring, supervision, and audit purposes.

Branch Operations assist:

  • Occasionally visit AIM clubs, attend YDC meetings, VSLA meetings, and follow up on ongoing different field-level trainings. Livelihood & education participants etc.
  • help with the mentors’ recruitment process
  • help with club space identification and completion of the agreement, club operations, participants' invitation according to the programme operations manual.
  • help with service provider mapping and establishment of working relationships.
  • help with identification of school(s) to deliver education assist as per the programme design.
  • Help to ensure timely disbursement of livelihood and education pathways assist to the participants.
  • Custody of all branch-level electronic devices and furniture and keep stock register.
  • Act as the technical focal point at the branch level to ensure the use of Binsight and other digital tools.

Safeguarding Responsibilities:

  • Ensure the safety of team members from any harm, abuse, neglect, harassment and exploitation to achieve the project goals on safeguarding implementation.
  • Act as a key source of assist, guidance and expertise on safeguarding for establishing a safe working environment.
  • Practice, promote and endorse the issues of safeguarding policy among team members and ensure the implementation of safeguarding standards in every course of action.
  • Follow the safeguarding reporting procedure in case any reportable incident takes place, encourage others to do so

Academic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance/Accounts/Business Administration/ Commerce and /or other relevant fields.

Required Skills, Competencies & Knowledge:

  • Experience in project management and coordination, including supervision and monitoring, administration, finance, and logistics
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills
  • Strong sense of teamwork and collaboration, and demonstrated ability to build relationships with individuals from diverse backgrounds
  • Personal qualities of integrity, credibility, and dedication to the mission of BRAC.

Experience Required:

  • At least 2 years’ experience in national/international development sector, including experience with managing finance and accounts for development programs including microfinance, livelihood, education, agricultural and food security, and/or girl’s and women’s empowerment programs.

About BRAC International:

BRAC International (BI), a leading non-profit organization, is on a mission to empower people and communities facing poverty, illiteracy, disease, and social injustice. Our vision is to create a world free from exploitation and discrimination, where everyone has the opportunity to realize their potential. We design proven, scalable solutions that equip people with the assist and confidence they need to achieve their potential.

BRAC was founded in Bangladesh in 1972 and over the last five decades has grown to become one of the world’s largest non-governmental organisations (NGOs), reaching over 100 million people. We started our first international operation by venturing into Afghanistan in 2002, building on lessons from our work in Bangladesh to assist a nation devastated by war. Currently operating in 16 countries across Asia and Africa. Born, proven and led in the Global South, BRAC International brings a unique Southern perspective and commitment to continuous learning, providing a depth of insight, experience and evidence to meet the needs of diverse communities with humility and courage across Asia and Africa. To learn more about BRAC International, please visit (www.bracinternational.org)

  • Integrity: We approach our collaborate with honesty and integrity.
  • Innovation: We innovate and iterate to enhance our impact.
  • Inclusiveness: We foster inclusion to reach those who need it most.
  • Effectiveness: We strive for effectiveness to better serve people in poverty.

greatrwandajobs.title: Senior Resource Development Manager job at World Vision
greatrwandajobs.description:
About World Vision International Rwanda

World Vision International Rwanda is a Christian humanitarian organization established in 1994 to provide emergency relief following the genocide, now focused on long-term development. It supports ove...

About This Opportunity

The position of Senior Resource Development Manager at World Vision International Rwanda located in Kigali, Rwanda offers an opportunity for qualified professionals to contribute their knowledge and experience in a dynamic working environment. The organization seeks individuals who are motivated, reliable, and capable of performing their duties effectively while maintaining professional standards.

JOB OPPORTUNITY

Senior Resource Development Manager

World Vision is a child-focused Christian humanitarian organization implementing development programmes in 30 Districts of Rwanda. Our interventions in the strategic period of 2026-2030 seek to reach 2.5 million of the most vulnerable children. This is done through programming in Child Protection, Education, Nutrition and WASH, and Poverty Alleviation (Resilience and Livelihoods).

World Vision Rwanda seeks to hire a highly qualified, dedicated, and experienced Rwandan national for the role ofSenior Resource Development Manager, joining an established and experienced team. This stimulating position incorporates a range of skills and development in multiple areas, allowing for an exciting opportunity for career growth in a dynamic, global organization. It will be based in Kigali at the Head Office and will report to theNational Director.

Purpose of the position:

The Senior Resource Development Manager provides strategic leadership and overall accountability for World Vision Rwanda's resource mobilization and external engagement agenda. The position leads the development and implementation of strategies that secure sustainable and diversified funding, strengthen organizational positioning, and advance strategic relationships that contribute to the achievement of World Vision Rwanda's Strategic Objectives. As a member of the Senior Leadership Team, the Manager provides organizational leadership on resource acquisition, donor engagement, funding diversification, business development, and market positioning across institutional, private sector, philanthropic, and domestic funding streams. The role ensures that World Vision Rwanda is strategically positioned within the development landscape, influences key stakeholders, and secures the resources required to deliver sustainable impact for vulnerable children, families, and communities. The Manager serves as a principal advisor to the National Director and Senior Leadership Team on donor trends, development financing, external relations, strategic opportunities, and organizational growth priorities.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES

15% Strategic Leadership and Organizational Growth

Effective implementation of World Vision Rwanda's Resource Mobilization Strategy, resulting in achievement of organizational resource acquisition objectives.

Diversified and sustainable funding portfolio that supports organizational growth, resilience, and long-term impact.

Strong alignment between resource acquisition priorities and National Strategy objectives, ensuring resources are directed toward strategic priorities.

Enhanced organizational decision-making through timely advisory support on funding opportunities, market trends, and resource mobilization risks.

A culture of innovation, accountability, and resource stewardship embedded across the organization, strengthening funding competitiveness and sustainability.

20% External Relations, Donor Engagement and Positioning

Enhanced organizational visibility, reputation, and influence among donors, government institutions, development partners, foundations, and private sector stakeholders.

Strong and sustainable strategic relationships established and maintained with senior donor representatives, decision-makers, and key development partners.

World Vision Rwanda positioned as a preferred and credible development partner in national, regional, and international forums.

Increased strategic partnership and resource acquisition opportunities through effective representation, stakeholder engagement, and high-level negotiations.

Knowledge/Qualifications for the role

Required Professional Experience

Minimum 7 - 10 years of progressive experience in resource mobilization, donor engagement, business development, strategic partnerships, and grant acquisition, including senior leadership responsibility.

Demonstrated track record of securing significant funding from institutional donors, bilateral and multilateral agencies, UN organizations, foundations, private sector partners, and domestic funding sources.

Proven experience leading resource acquisition and business development functions, including donor positioning, funding pipeline management, partnership development, opportunity prioritization, and strategic funding decisions.

Experience overseeing donor intelligence, portfolio management, funding diversification, and resource mobilization systems to support long-term organizational growth and impact.

Extensive experience building and managing high-level relationships with donors, government institutions, development partners, foundations, private sector leaders, and other strategic stakeholders.

Demonstrated success leading complex proposal development processes, consortium building, negotiations, and high-value funding pursuits involving multidisciplinary teams and multiple stakeholders.

Experience advising senior leadership on donor trends, development financing, funding risks, resource mobilization strategies, and organizational growth opportunities.

Proven leadership experience in developing high-performing teams, strengthening organizational capacity, and driving resource mobilization performance and sustainability.

Required Education, training, license, registration, and certification

Education

Master's Degree in International Development, Business Administration, Economics, Public Policy, International Relations, Communications, Social Sciences, or a related field.

A Bachelor's Degree in a relevant discipline, combined with substantial senior-level resource mobilization and leadership experience, may be considered.

NOTE: If a foreign institution issued the degree, an equivalence certificate from the Rwanda Higher Education Council (HEC) will be required)

Professional Training

Advanced training in resource mobilization, donor engagement, business development, strategic partnerships, fundraising, grant acquisition, or organizational growth.

Training in strategic planning, development financing, results-based management, proposal design, donor compliance, and grant management is an advantage.

Professional Certifications (Desirable)

Professional certification in Project Management (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent).

Certification in fundraising, resource mobilization, grant management, business development, partnership management, or leadership development.

Additional certifications in strategic planning, organizational development, MEAL, or Results-Based Management are desirable.

License / Registration

No specific professional license or registration required.

Other Requirements

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and resource mobilization, donor intelligence, pipeline management, and grants management systems.

Excellent written, presentation, negotiation, and verbal communication skills in English.

Demonstrated ability to engage and influence senior-level stakeholders, including donors, government officials, development partners, foundations, and private sector leaders.

Preferred Knowledge and Qualifications

Strong knowledge of strategic resource mobilization, donor engagement, business development, grant acquisition, funding diversification, and partnership development within the international development and humanitarian sectors.

In-depth understanding of bilateral, multilateral, UN, Foundations and Trusts, government, private sector, and domestic funding mechanisms, donor priorities, compliance requirements, and evolving development financing trends.

Sound knowledge of organizational growth strategies, market positioning, consortium development, localization approaches, and partnership models that strengthen competitiveness and sustainable funding acquisition.

Familiarity with project design, results-based management, proposal development, budgeting, grant management, and funding portfolio oversight.

Knowledge of donor intelligence platforms, pipeline management systems, grants management tools, and resource mobilization reporting frameworks.

Strong strategic thinking, analytical, stakeholder management, networking, influencing, negotiation, and communication capabilities, with the ability to engage effectively at senior levels.

Experience working in international development, humanitarian, faith-based, or comparable sectors, with a strong understanding of the external funding environment.

Professional training or certification in project management, resource mobilization, fundraising, grant management, business development, strategic partnerships, leadership, or related fields is an added advantage.

Travel and/or Work Environment Requirement

Travel to the field (20%)

Physical Requirements

Language Requirements

English proficiency

Key Working Relationships

Contact (within WV or outside WV): Senior Leadership Team (SLT)

Reason for contact: Provide strategic advice and updates on resource mobilization performance, funding opportunities, donor trends, business development priorities, portfolio health, funding risks, and organizational positioning. Support strategic planning, decision-making, funding diversification, and alignment of resource acquisition efforts with World Vision Rwanda's strategic objectives.

N.B: Women are highly encouraged to apply.

  • Enhanced organizational visibility, reputation, and influence among donors, government institutions, development partners, foundations, and private sector stakeholders.
  • Strong and sustainable strategic relationships established and maintained with senior donor representatives, decision-makers, and key development partners.
  • World Vision Rwanda positioned as a preferred and credible development partner in national, regional, and international forums.
  • Increased strategic partnership and resource acquisition opportunities through effective representation, stakeholder engagement, and high-level negotiations.

Knowledge/Qualifications for the role

Required Professional Experience

  • Minimum 7 - 10 years of progressive experience in resource mobilization, donor engagement, business development, strategic partnerships, and grant acquisition, including senior leadership responsibility.
  • Demonstrated track record of securing significant funding from institutional donors, bilateral and multilateral agencies, UN organizations, foundations, private sector partners, and domestic funding sources.
  • Proven experience leading resource acquisition and business development functions, including donor positioning, funding pipeline management, partnership development, opportunity prioritization, and strategic funding decisions.
  • Experience overseeing donor intelligence, portfolio management, funding diversification, and resource mobilization systems to support long-term organizational growth and impact.
  • Extensive experience building and managing high-level relationships with donors, government institutions, development partners, foundations, private sector leaders, and other strategic stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex proposal development processes, consortium building, negotiations, and high-value funding pursuits involving multidisciplinary teams and multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience advising senior leadership on donor trends, development financing, funding risks, resource mobilization strategies, and organizational growth opportunities.
  • Proven leadership experience in developing high-performing teams, strengthening organizational capacity, and driving resource mobilization performance and sustainability.

Required Education, training, license, registration, and certification

Education

  • Master's Degree in International Development, Business Administration, Economics, Public Policy, International Relations, Communications, Social Sciences, or a related field.
  • A Bachelor's Degree in a relevant discipline, combined with substantial senior-level resource mobilization and leadership experience, may be considered.
  • NOTE: If a foreign institution issued the degree, an equivalence certificate from the Rwanda Higher Education Council (HEC) will be required)

Professional Training

  • Advanced training in resource mobilization, donor engagement, business development, strategic partnerships, fundraising, grant acquisition, or organizational growth.
  • Training in strategic planning, development financing, results-based management, proposal design, donor compliance, and grant management is an advantage.

Professional Certifications (Desirable)

  • Professional certification in Project Management (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent).
  • Certification in fundraising, resource mobilization, grant management, business development, partnership management, or leadership development.
  • Additional certifications in strategic planning, organizational development, MEAL, or Results-Based Management are desirable.

License / Registration

  • No specific professional license or registration required.

Other Requirements

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and resource mobilization, donor intelligence, pipeline management, and grants management systems.
  • Excellent written, presentation, negotiation, and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage and influence senior-level stakeholders, including donors, government officials, development partners, foundations, and private sector leaders.

Preferred Knowledge and Qualifications

  • Strong knowledge of strategic resource mobilization, donor engagement, business development, grant acquisition, funding diversification, and partnership development within the international development and humanitarian sectors.
  • In-depth understanding of bilateral, multilateral, UN, Foundations and Trusts, government, private sector, and domestic funding mechanisms, donor priorities, compliance requirements, and evolving development financing trends.
  • Sound knowledge of organizational growth strategies, market positioning, consortium development, localization approaches, and partnership models that strengthen competitiveness and sustainable funding acquisition.
  • Familiarity with project design, results-based management, proposal development, budgeting, grant management, and funding portfolio oversight.
  • Knowledge of donor intelligence platforms, pipeline management systems, grants management tools, and resource mobilization reporting frameworks.
  • Strong strategic thinking, analytical, stakeholder management, networking, influencing, negotiation, and communication capabilities, with the ability to engage effectively at senior levels.
  • Experience working in international development, humanitarian, faith-based, or comparable sectors, with a strong understanding of the external funding environment.
  • Professional training or certification in project management, resource mobilization, fundraising, grant management, business development, strategic partnerships, leadership, or related fields is an added advantage.

Travel and/or Work Environment Requirement

  • Travel to the field (20%)

Physical Requirements

Language Requirements

  • English proficiency

Key Working Relationships

  • Contact (within WV or outside WV): Senior Leadership Team (SLT)
  • Reason for contact: Provide strategic advice and updates on resource mobilization performance, funding opportunities, donor trends, business development priorities, portfolio health, funding risks, and organizational positioning. Support strategic planning, decision-making, funding diversification, and alignment of resource acquisition efforts with World Vision Rwanda's strategic objectives.

N.B: Women are highly encouraged to apply.

greatrwandajobs.description:
About Trinity Musha Mines Ltd

Trinity Musha Mines Limited is a Rwandan mining company that operates the Musha mine and is a subsidiary of Trinity Metals Limited.

Who May Be Interested

Professionals seeking career advancement and individuals with relevant qualifications may be interested in this opportunity.

This opportunity is ideal for professionals interested in the role of Mining Supervisor based in Kigali, Rwanda. Qualified and motivated candidates are encouraged to apply for this full-time opportunity.

About This Opportunity

The position of Mining Supervisor at Trinity Musha Mines Ltd located in Kigali, Rwanda offers an opportunity for qualified professionals to contribute their knowledge and experience in a dynamic working environment. The organization seeks individuals who are motivated, reliable, and capable of performing their duties effectively while maintaining professional standards.

Common Skills Required

Communication

Teamwork

Leadership

Management

Excel

Training

JOB ADVERT - Mining Supervisor

Trinity Musha Mines Ltd is a Mining company focused on the production and exploration of Tin, Tantalum, and Lithium in Rwanda. Trinity Musha is currently inviting suitable candidates to apply for the following position:

i. Position/Job Title: Mine Supervisor

ii. Grade: C4

iii. Department: Mining

iv. Reports To: Mining Section Leader

Job Brief:The Mine Supervisor is tasked with overseeing and coordinating the day-to-day mining operations to ensure safe, efficient, and productive mining activities within the designated area.

Responsibilities:The Mine Supervisor has the following responsibilities and duties:

1. Supervise Mining Operations:

organize and direct mining activities, including drilling, blasting, excavation, hauling, and ore processing, to meet production targets and quality standards.

Allocate resources, such as manpower, equipment, and materials, to optimize efficiency and productivity.

track production schedules, equipment performance, and ore grades to detect and address operational issues or bottlenecks.

Supports the Mining Team Leaders to make sure that production team delivers on the daily planned production and necessary measures are taken whenever the production targets are not met.

Observe and enforce any code of practice, instructions, procedures, directives, permissions, exemptions etc. issued by the Mine Manager or any other person authorized to do so

2. Ensure Health and Safety Compliance:

Inspect all other workings, in your area of responsibility, at least once a week

Be tasked with the proper discipline of all persons working under your charge deliver and keep a working environment that is safe and without risk to the health and safety of employees within your area of responsibility

detect relevant hazards and assess the related risks within your area of responsibility

execute and enforce safety protocols, procedures, and regulations to minimize risks and prevent accidents or injuries.

perform regular safety inspections, hazard assessments, and safety training sessions for mining personnel.

Investigate incidents or near misses, report findings, and recommend corrective actions to enhance safety performance.

Ensure adherence to the SHEC laws, regulations and policies

3. keep Equipment and Infrastructure:

Oversee maintenance and repair activities for mining equipment, vehicles, and infrastructure to ensure operational reliability and longevity.

Schedule preventive maintenance tasks, inspections, and repairs to minimize downtime and maximize equipment availability.

organize with maintenance staff and suppliers to procure spare parts, components, and consumables as needed.

4. Management of Personnel:

make sure that people under your supervision adhere to HR Policies and Procedures

deliver Employees within your area of responsibility with any information, instructions or supervision that is necessary to enable them to perform their work professionally, safely and without risks

Consider Employees’ training and capabilities before assigning tasks to them

make sure that all persons working under your charge are fully trained on job training or otherwise in their tasks.

tasked with staffing needs of the area of responsibility

Supervise and mentor mining staff, including operators and labourers, to ensure adherence to company policies, procedures, and performance standards.

deliver leadership, guidance, and assist to promote teamwork, motivation, and professional development among team members.

perform performance evaluations, deliver feedback, and address disciplinary issues or concerns in accordance with HR policies.

5. Environmental track and Compliance:

Ensure compliance with environmental regulations, permits, and standards governing mining operations, waste management, and land reclamation.

execute environmental management practices, such as erosion control, water management, and rehabilitation measures, to minimize environmental impacts.

6. Data Collection and Reporting:

Record in ink in your logbook the following during or at the conclusion of your shift:

The designation of every working place or other working place inspected by yourself during your shift

Particularly of any unsatisfactory conditions of working places, traveling ways or other workings in your area of responsibility as observed by yourself or reported to you by the Mine team leader or any other person, specifically in respect of ground conditions and where safety of people are concerned

Any instructions given by you to secure the health and safety of persons under your charge and adhered to.

Give regular reports on the Production, HSEC, Security and HR to the Section team leader / Site manager for your designated area of responsibility.

produce regular reports, dashboards, and presentations for management evaluate, highlighting key operational KPIs, trends, and challenges.

7. Job Requirements:The Mine Supervisor should have the following education, experience and skills:

Bachelor’s degree/Advanced diploma in mining Engineering

At least 3 years Certification in mining from a competent mining school

Experience of at least 3 years in the field.

Physical fitness.

Excellent Communication skills (English preferable)

Willing to work overtime

Good supervisor skills and be able to delegate different work to workers/Team work spirit

Equal Opportunity Employer

Trinity Musha Mines Ltd values diversity and inclusion. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, ethnicity, disability, or background.

greatrwandajobs.description:

Responsibilities or duties

1. Teaching

Assist lecturers in preparation field work and practices

Assist lecturers in invigilation and marking of courses in his/her area of specialization

Participate in the assessment and evaluation of students through continual assessment tests and examinations

Participate in organization of practices in classrooms, library and laboratories.

Participate in research proposals implementation trough data collection and entry for analysis,

Conduct consultancy activities in his area of specialization

Compete successfully for income generating consultancies

Qualifications or requirements (e.g., education, skills)

Bachelor of Science (BSc) in Information Technology with Education

Publications in peer-reviewed journals.

Postgraduate Certificate in Teaching and Learning in Higher Education or a validated Teaching Portfolio Certificate.

Tutorial Assistant Department of Early Childhood Education (ECD) Under Contract - CE at university of rwanda (UR). Level:4.II. Posts:4. Under Contract.

Responsibilities or duties

1. Teaching

  • Assist lecturers in preparation field work and practices
  • Assist lecturers in invigilation and marking of courses in his/her area of specialization
  • Participate in the assessment and evaluation of students through continual assessment tests and examinations
  • Participate in organization of practices in classrooms, library and laboratories.

2. Research

  • Participate in research proposals implementation trough data collection and entry for analysis,
  • Participate in the elaboration of research protocols.
  • Participate in research activities aiming at solving community problems
  • Participate in publishing research results at national, regional and international levels

3. Community Outreach

  • Participate in dissemination of research findings to relevant stakeholders
  • Conduct research projects which may lead to PhD studies
  • Participate in organizing national scientific conferences

4. Consultancy

  • Conduct consultancy activities in his area of specialization
  • Compete successfully for income generating consultancies

Qualifications or requirements (e.g., education, skills)

5. Relevant Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree with at least a second class upper division or at least 70% of :

  • Bachelor of Education / BA / BSc in Early Childhood Education
  • Bachelor of Education / BA / BSc in Early Childhood Development (ECD)
  • Bachelor of Education in Child Development
  • Bachelor of Education in Early Childhood and Family Education
  • Bachelor of Education in Primary Education
  • Bachelor of Education in Early Childhood and Primary Education
  • Bachelor of Education in Curriculum Studies
  • Bachelor of Education in Inclusive Early Childhood Education
  • Bachelor of Education in Special Needs Education (Early Childhood option)
  • Bachelor of Education in Child Psychology and Education
  • Bachelor of Education in Educational Psychology (with specialization in Child Development or Primary Education)
  • Bachelor of Education in Foundations of Education (English)
  • Bachelor of Education in Science and Mathematics Education
  • Bachelor of Education in Social Studies
  • Bachelor of Education in History
  • Bachelor of Education in Geography

6. Desirable Qualifications and Experience

  • Publications in peer-reviewed journals.
  • Relevant teaching experience in Higher Learning Institutions.
  • Postgraduate Certificate in Teaching and Learning in Higher Education or a validated Teaching Portfolio Certificate.

Any other provided details (e.g., benefits, work environment, team info, or additional notes)

Exams to be conducted

  • Psychometric Test
  • Oral

greatrwandajobs.title: Rwanda Driver (Fixed-Term) job at One Acre Fund
greatrwandajobs.description:
About the Role

Seeking a driver to transport agricultural and non-agricultural inputs between OAF sites, maintain the fleet and cargo in excellent condition, and provide insights on truck operations and charging to inform future electric truck ownership.

Responsibilities

Cargo Transport

Transport agricultural and non-agricultural inputs between assigned OAF sites, ensuring delivery strictly to the specified locations within set timelines.

Collaborate with the warehouse team to load, offload, and reload trucks, verifying that the physical cargo matches the exact quantity and quality stated on delivery documents.

Secure all materials in transit using appropriate equipment to prevent loss, theft, tampering, or damage (e.g., perforations, wet bags, or torn stitching).

Proactively gather information regarding the location and accessibility of field sites and chargers within the assigned district prior to departure.

Vehicle Maintenance

Conduct weekly vehicle checks, perform minor repairs, and submit maintenance requests to your manager to ensure that the vehicle under their care is kept in good running condition at all times.

Mitigate damage to the truck by avoiding risky routes or driving techniques.

Ensure safety and custody of the vehicles including tools.

Ensure availability of all the required documents/supplies including vehicle insurance, registration, first aid kit, and necessary spare parts in the assigned vehicle.

Ensure that, in the event of an accident involving the vehicle, the necessary steps required by rules and regulations are followed.

Documentation & Communication

Accurately manage all delivery documents, including Delivery Notes, Load Cards, and Truck Management Sheets (TMS). Return fully signed delivery documents to your manager within one (1) business day of delivery.

Obtain official signatures from authorized OAF representatives at both the originating and destination sites to confirm the exact weight/number of inputs dispatched and received.

Immediately notify your manager via text (or call for urgent cases) in the event of accidents, field staff unavailability, data discrepancies, charging problems, mechanical problems, adverse weather, route accessibility issues, data discrepancies, or if any party refuses to sign the delivery documents.

Communicate regularly relevant trial information, such as GPS coordinates, KM range, battery levels, charging experience, driving experience, road quality, etc.

Ensure that all required driving training is successfully completed and certifications are kept up to date

Career Growth and Development

We have a strong culture of constant learning and we invest in developing our people. You’ll have weekly check-ins with your manager, access to mentorship and training programs, and regular feedback on your performance. We hold career reviews every six months, and set aside time to discuss your aspirations and career goals. You’ll have the opportunity to shape a growing organization and build a rewarding long-term career.

Qualifications

Across all roles, these are the general qualifications we look for. For this role specifically, you will have:

Valid category C driver’s licence

Experience driving cargo trucks on dirt roads outside of Kigali

Working knowledge of local roads and routes, ability to utilize maps / GPS systems

Working knowledge of electric vehicle mechanics (truck maintenance, interpret truck KM range / battery life)

Sound knowledge of road safety regulations

Effective communication skills (verbal and written) in Kinyarwanda

Punctual and reliable, customer service

Preferred Start Date

As soon as possible

Job Location

Kigali, Rwanda

Benefits

Health insurance, paid time off

Contract Duration

3 months

Eligibility

This role is only open to citizens or permanent residents of Rwanda.

greatrwandajobs.title: Rwanda Seed Quality Control Coordinator job at One Acre Fund
greatrwandajobs.location: Eastern Province, Gatsibo District, Kabarore, Rwanda | Kigali
greatrwandajobs.description:
About the Role

Seeking an agriculture professional with 1–2 years of Hybrid Maize seed industry experience and a Bachelor's in Agriculture to serve as Seed Quality Control Coordinator. You will oversee quality, SOPs, and compliance for our 4,000 MT processing plant.

Responsibilities

Seed Quality Assurance & SOP Compliance

Oversee comprehensive quality assurance, SOP implementation, and regulatory compliance across every stage of the 4,000 MT seed processing plant to meet partner, client, and regulatory standards.

Processing Plant Operations & Technical Guidance

Partner closely with the Processing Coordinator to provide technical guidance, conduct continuous quality inspections, and balance operational efficiency with production targets.

People & Team Management

Lead and manage plant quality staff and casual workers, driving capacity building and training to ensure strict adherence to SOPs and quality standards.

Stakeholder Management & System Improvement

Act as the primary liaison between internal processing teams, external clients, and regulatory bodies while continuously strengthening quality control systems across the seed value chain.

Career Growth and Development

We have a strong culture of constant learning and we invest in developing our people. You’ll have weekly check-ins with your manager, access to mentorship and training programs, and regular feedback on your performance. We hold career reviews every six months, and set aside time to discuss your aspirations and career goals. You’ll have the opportunity to shape a growing organization and build a rewarding long-term career.

Qualifications

Across all roles, these are the general qualifications we look for. For this role specifically, you will have:

1–2 years of experience in the hybrid maize seed industry, seed quality control, or plant operations.

Bachelor's degree in Agriculture

Proven expertise in seed quality assurance, SOP development, and regulatory compliance

Demonstrated technical understanding of 4,000 MT processing plant operations and quality risk mitigation.

Strong leadership and people management skills with experience training diverse plant staff and casual workers

Preferred Start Date

As soon as possible

Benefits

Health insurance, paid time off

Eligibility

This role is only open to citizens or permanent residents of Rwanda.

greatrwandajobs.title: Legal Officer job at Ecofleet Solutions Ltd
greatrwandajobs.description:
1. ROLE SUMMARY

The Legal Officer supports the Head of Legal & Company Secretary in providing sound legal advice, drafting and reviewing corporate documents, and managing legal risks to protect the commercial and regulatory interests of Ecofleet Solutions Ltd.

2. SCOPE OF THE ROLE

The role involves supporting corporate governance, contract management, regulatory compliance, and litigation processes. The Legal Officer works closely with internal departments and external counsel, reporting directly to the Head of Legal & Company Secretary.

3. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Draft, review, and negotiate commercial contracts, agreements, and MOUs.

Provide legal opinions on labor law, commercial transactions, and intellectual property matters.

Maintain statutory records and ensure timely corporate filings with RDB and relevant authorities.

Coordinate with external counsel on litigation and represent the company in administrative proceedings where required.

Review and update internal policies to ensure legal and regulatory compliance.

Identify and mitigate legal risks across company operations.

4. WORKING RELATIONSHIPS

The Legal Officer maintains the following key working relationships:

Head of Legal & Company Secretary: Direct reporting line; legal strategy and escalation of key legal matters.

Internal Departments: Legal advisory support on contracts, transactions, and compliance matters.

External Counsel: Coordination on litigation and specialised legal matters.

RDB & Regulatory Authorities: Corporate filings and regulatory compliance.

5. INDICATORS OF SUCCESS

Legal documents reviewed and returned within 48-72 hours.

Minimisation of legal exposure and successful out-of-court settlements.

100% compliance with statutory filing deadlines.

6. CORE COMPETENCIES & SKILLS

Excellent legal drafting and negotiation skills.

Fluent in English and Kinyarwanda; French is an added advantage.

Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.

7. VALUES & CULTURAL FIT

High integrity and professionalism in legal practice.

Sound judgement and attention to detail.

Collaborative approach with internal departments and external counsel.

Commitment to protecting Ecofleet's legal and commercial interests.

8. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum:

Bachelor of Laws (LL.B) and Diploma in Legal Practice (DLP).

Minimum of 4 years of post-qualification legal experience in a corporate environment or law firm.

Preferred:

Experience in logistics, transport, or fleet management sectors is an advantage.

greatrwandajobs.title: Digital Innovation & Analytics Officer job at Ecofleet Solutions Ltd
greatrwandajobs.description:
1. ROLE SUMMARY

The Digital Innovation & Analytics Officer drives data-driven decision-making and innovation across Ecofleet's operations and digital ecosystem. Reporting to the CDXO, the role focuses on transforming data into actionable insights, identifying opportunities for innovation, and supporting the continuous improvement of services, systems, and customer experience. The Officer plays a central role in analytics, reporting, and digital innovation, working across departments to unlock value from data and support strategic and operational performance.

2. SCOPE OF THE ROLE

The Digital Innovation & Analytics Officer develops and manages data analytics frameworks and reporting systems, analyzes operational, financial, and digital data to generate insights, and identifies and supports the implementation of digital innovation initiatives. The role builds dashboards and visualization tools for decision-making, supports predictive analytics and performance optimization efforts, and promotes a data-driven culture across the organization.

3. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Collect, clean, and analyze data from multiple sources (FMS, finance systems, digital platforms, operations).

Develop and maintain dashboards and reports for operational and executive use.

Identify trends, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities across fleet operations and customer experience.

Support development of predictive models (e.g., demand forecasting, maintenance planning, route optimization).

Collaborate with the M&E Officer to align KPI tracking and reporting frameworks.

Work with the FMS Product Officer and Platform & UX Officer to enhance data availability and usability.

Explore and recommend innovative digital solutions (automation, AI, data tools) to improve performance.

Support pilot projects and innovation initiatives with data analysis and evaluation.

Ensure data quality, consistency, and governance across systems.

Present insights and recommendations to leadership in a clear and actionable manner.

4. WORKING RELATIONSHIPS

The Digital Innovation & Analytics Officer maintains the following key working relationships:

CDXO: Strategic direction on analytics and innovation priorities.

FMS Product Officer: Access to fleet data and system-based insights.

Platform & UX Officer: User behavior analytics and experience optimization.

Enterprise IT & Cybersecurity Officer: Data infrastructure, security, and governance.

M&E Officer: Alignment of KPIs, reporting standards, and performance frameworks.

COO: Operational insights and performance optimization.

CFO: Financial analytics and cost optimization.

CSEO: Sustainability metrics and environmental performance tracking.

Data & Analytics Solution Providers: Tools, platforms, and technical support.

Consultants, Research & Innovation Partners: Support on analytics and innovation initiatives.

5. INDICATORS OF SUCCESS

Availability of accurate, timely, and actionable analytics dashboards.

Increased use of data in operational and strategic decision-making.

Measurable improvements driven by data insights (efficiency, cost savings, service quality).

Successful implementation of innovation initiatives and pilots.

Strong alignment between analytics outputs and business needs.

Improved data quality and consistency across systems.

6. CORE COMPETENCIES & SKILLS

Strong analytical and data interpretation skills.

Proficiency in data tools (Excel, Power BI, SQL, or similar).

Understanding of data modeling, visualization, and reporting.

Ability to translate data into actionable insights.

Curiosity and innovation mindset.

Strong communication and presentation skills.

Attention to detail and data accuracy.

7. VALUES & CULTURAL FIT

Data-driven mindset and commitment to evidence-based decisions.

Curiosity and continuous improvement.

Collaboration across departments.

Accountability and ownership of insights and outcomes.

Passion for innovation in mobility and public service.

8. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum:

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field.

3-5 years' experience in data analysis, analytics, or digital innovation roles.

Preferred:

Experience in transport, logistics, energy, or infrastructure sectors.

Strong skills in Power BI, SQL, Python, or similar tools.

Experience with predictive analytics or machine learning (basic to intermediate).

Experience working with cross-functional teams and executive stakeholders.

Exposure to digital transformation or innovation projects.

greatrwandajobs.title: Marketing Specialist-Remote-Africa & Asia job at Talents2Germany
greatrwandajobs.description:
About Talents2Germany:
Talents2Germany connects highly qualified international technology professionals with employers in Germany. Our mission is to make global hiring work efficiently— for both companies and candidates.

Your role:
Marketing at Talents2Germany is highly diverse. Depending on your strengths, you may work across multiple areas, including:

Strong collaboration & sync with sales

Content Marketing

AEO / SEO (Answer Engine Optimization & Search Engine Optimization)

LinkedIn Growth

Email Marketing

Marketing Automation

CRM Management

Webinar Preparation

Graphic Design / Video Editing

Landing Page Optimization

Customized sales offer preparation

AI-supported Content Creation

Creating exceptional marketing and sales materials for employer acquisition

Creating high-end presentations, proposals and documents with outstanding attention to detail and visual quality

What we are looking for:
You are likely a strong fit if you:

Have what it takes to win EU employers to work with our amazing, global tech talent!

Have an exceptional eye for detail, consistency and quality.

Take genuine pride in producing work that is polished and accurate. Without needing feedback.

Enjoy refining documents, presentations and marketing materials until they meet a very high standard.

Think from the employer’s perspective and continuously ask whether the message is truly relevant, convincing and easy to understand.

Naturally identify inconsistencies, missing information and opportunities for improvement.

Balance creativity with precision and structured thinking.

Take ownership of your work instead of simply executing tasks.

Are comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

Always one of the first testing new tools without needing to be asked to do so, especially AI-powered marketing tools.

Bonus, if you are KPI-driven. In the best case you do marketing not only for the sake of it, but for the measurable results it brings.

What we offer:

Globally distributed, remote team with the ability to work from home

High level of discipline and focus, if that’s what you love, you’ll love being here!

Value & meaning: you help other people to get global employment opportunities and help us to reduce global income inequality. We are on a mission!

Low hirarchies: we collaborate, you definitely have a contribution & an impact!

Salary: on average about 50% higher than the local salary in your homecountry. While you can work from home.

Great fellow team members & a mutually supportive work-environment!

We value Craftmanship:
Outstanding marketing & sales is rarely the result of a single brilliant idea. More often, it is the result of someone who cares enough to improve every sentence, every slide, every visual and every detail.

We appreciate people who enjoy producing work that feels finished—not just completed. People who notice inconsistencies, improve structure, question assumptions and continuously raise the quality of their own work.

If you find satisfaction in turning something good into something exceptional, you will likely enjoy working with us.

greatrwandajobs.title: Compliance Manager job at Prime Insurance Ltd
greatrwandajobs.description:
Background

Prime Insurance Ltd is an insurance company, established in 1995 and licensed by the National Bank of Rwanda (BNR) to offer general insurance services.

Job Purpose

The Compliance Manager is a key strategic role responsible for ensuring the company operates within legal and regulatory frameworks and QMS compliance and improvement. This role identifies, assesses, and mitigates compliance risks, implements policies, and provides guidance to uphold ethical standards, protecting the company from financial and reputational harm while fostering a strong compliance culture and driving continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Under the supervision of the Chief Executive Officer, the Compliance Manager shall have the following responsibilities:

Ensure compliance with laws, regulations, and directives issued by regulatory authorities (BNR, FIC, NCSA) and industry bodies.

Monitor compliance risks and assess the effectiveness of corrective measures across the organization.

Report significant compliance breaches and oversee corrective actions arising from regulatory findings.

Lead the implementation and monitoring of AML/CFT compliance programs.

Develop, maintain, and promote compliance policies, procedures, ethical standards, and internal controls.

Deliver compliance training and awareness programs to foster a strong compliance culture.

Oversee the Quality Management System (QMS), including ISO 9001 certification and continuous improvement initiatives.

Monitor quality performance, customer feedback, and operational risks, and drive corrective and preventive actions.

Key Deliverables

Effective regulatory monitoring and compliance reporting.

Comprehensive compliance risk assessments and monitoring plans.

Timely management of compliance incidents and regulatory actions.

Successful implementation of AML/CFT requirements.

Maintenance and continual improvement of the QMS and ISO 9001 certification.

Regular compliance reports to management and Board committees.

Strong regulatory relationships and effective stakeholder communication.

Required Qualifications & Experience

Regulatory approval required prior to appointment.

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Risk Management, or a related field; a Master's degree is an added advantage.

Professional qualification such as CPA, ACCA, a diploma in insurance issued by Chartered Insurance Institute (UK) or by a similar professional body recognized by the Supervisory Authority or any other professional certificate in the area of compliance. ISO 9001 related qualification will be an added advantage

At least 5 years of progressive experience in compliance, audit, or risk management within financial services, including 3 years in a managerial role.

Experience in Quality Management Systems and ISO 9001 implementation or auditing.

Strong knowledge of regulatory requirements and proficiency in English, French, and Kinyarwanda.

Rwandan nationality and below 45 years of age

Key Competencies

Regulatory Compliance and AML/CFT expertise.

Ability to identify, assess, and mitigate compliance risks effectively.

Quality Management system proficiency.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

Excellent communication and stakeholders’ management.

High ethical standards, integrity, and attention to detail.

Ability to adapt to evolving regulations and business environments.

Working Relationships

Internal: Board of Directors, CEO, Senior Management Committee, Heads of Departments, all staff across the organization.

External: Regulatory authorities, External Auditors, Industry Associations, Intermediaries.

greatrwandajobs.title: Technical Support Engineer job at Wicloud
greatrwandajobs.description:
COMPANY INTRODUCTION

Wicloudrwd is a global digital transformation and IT outsourcing company established in 2022, with operations across multiple international locations. The company provides technology and IT outsourcing solutions tailored to Microsoft environments, with expertise across Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Windows Commercial, and Microsoft Office 365.

Location: Rwanda

Employment Type: Freelancer

About the Role

We are seeking Technical Support Engineers to provide technical support to Microsoft global customers. The role involves investigating technical issues, developing effective solutions, supporting customer satisfaction, and documenting technical knowledge to improve the overall support experience.

The successful candidate will combine technical problem-solving skills with strong communication and customer service capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

1. Technical Support & Responsiveness

Deliver technical support services to Microsoft global customers while maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction.

Scope customer issues by collecting relevant facts and investigating problems through independent research and collaboration with other teams.

Determine the most effective approach to resolving complex technical issues, balancing efficiency and speed to resolution with quality.

Empower customers to find information, self-solve issues when appropriate, and learn more about Microsoft products, services, and support.

Advise customers on how to gain additional value from their Microsoft products and services.

2. Technical Investigation & Documentation

Conduct technical research and troubleshooting to identify appropriate solutions.

Document technical work, findings, and research to support colleagues and improve the product and customer support experience.

Collaborate with relevant teams when additional technical expertise is required.

3. Customer Experience

Maintain a proactive approach to customer satisfaction.

Identify customer satisfaction concerns and manage customer expectations appropriately.

Communicate technical information clearly and professionally.

4. Team & Service Coverage

Collaborate effectively with colleagues and other technical teams.

Participate in planned team-wide shift rotations to support business needs.

Qualifications & Requirements

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronic Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

1–3 years of IT experience.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Strong self-motivation and ability to work effectively as part of a team.

Strong verbal and written English skills.

Strong analytical and logical thinking skills.

Understanding of Microsoft Cloud technologies, including Azure and/or Microsoft 365, and Windows Server products or other application server technologies.

Ability to provide remote technical support and resolve mission-critical issues for enterprise customers.

Strong commitment to delivering high-quality technical support and customer service.

Language Requirements

Local Language: Fluent in reading, writing, and speaking.

English: Strong professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

greatrwandajobs.title: Finance Lead job at Wicloud
greatrwandajobs.description:
COMPANY INTRODUCTION

Wicloudrwd is a global digital transformation and IT outsourcing company established in 2022, with operations across multiple international locations. The company provides technology and IT outsourcing solutions tailored to Microsoft environments, with expertise across Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Windows Commercial, and Microsoft Office 365.

Location: Kigali, Rwanda

Employment Type: Full-time

Working Hours: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM

About the Role

We are seeking a hands-on Finance Lead to independently manage the Company's routine accounting, tax compliance, payroll, project costing, and local finance administration.

The Finance Lead will work closely with the Kigali team and HQ Finance & Operations functions to ensure accurate financial reporting, strong financial controls, and compliance with applicable Rwanda requirements.

The successful candidate must be able to independently perform core finance activities and possess a sound academic and professional understanding of more complex financial and tax concepts.

Key Responsibilities

1. Accounting & Financial Reporting

Independently manage full-cycle accounting, including:

Journal entries.

Accounts payable and receivable.

Accruals and bank reconciliations.

Fixed asset records and depreciation.

Manage month-end closing and preparation of monthly financial reports.

Maintain accurate accounting records and supporting documentation.

Prepare schedules and information for management, audit, and statutory purposes.

2. Tax, Invoice & Payroll Compliance

Independently manage routine Rwanda finance and compliance matters, including:

VAT, PAYE, withholding tax, and other applicable statutory obligations.

Invoice and supporting document compliance.

Payroll records, statutory deductions, and employer contributions.

Tax filing deadlines, supporting documentation, and statutory records.

Coordinate with the Rwanda Revenue Authority, auditors, and external tax advisors.

Review the accounting and basic tax treatment of revenue and expense transactions and identify potential tax benefits or exposures.

3. Project Costing & Financial Control

Maintain project and cost center records.

Track and allocate direct and indirect costs.

Prepare project costing, profitability analysis, and budget-versus-actual reporting.

Support cash-flow forecasting and management reporting.

Identify financial control or compliance issues and report them to management or relevant HQ functions.

4. Financial Administration & External Coordination

Prepare payment documentation and maintain finance records in accordance with company policies.

Support the implementation of finance SOPs and internal controls.

Act as the primary local finance contact for banks, auditors, accounting firms, and tax advisors.

Coordinate with external advisors on tax, accounting, and regulatory matters and follow up on agreed actions.

Prepare information and supporting documents requested by HQ or external advisors.

greatrwandajobs.title: Windows Forum Freelancer JD job at Wicloud
greatrwandajobs.description:
COMPANY INTRODUCTION

Wicloudrwd is a global digital transformation and IT outsourcing company established in 2022, with operations across multiple international locations. The company provides technology and IT outsourcing solutions tailored to Microsoft environments, with expertise across Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Windows Commercial, and Microsoft Office 365.

Location: Rwanda

Employment Type: Freelancer

About the Role

We are seeking motivated freelancers to join the Windows Community Forum team on Microsoft Learn. As a freelancer, you will play a vital role in supporting users worldwide by managing community threads, providing accurate solutions, and ensuring a positive experience for all members.

This is a flexible opportunity for individuals who want to develop their technical expertise while earning income through community support activities.

Key Responsibilities

Community Thread Management

Review and respond to user questions in the Windows Community Forum.

Monitor assigned community threads and ensure questions receive appropriate attention.

Maintain a professional, respectful, and helpful interaction with community members.

Technical Support & Problem Resolution

Research user issues using approved knowledge bases and training materials.

Provide clear, accurate, and solution-oriented responses.

Help users understand available solutions and relevant Microsoft resources.

Escalation & Follow-up

Escalate unresolved or advanced cases for senior support or moderator review.

Follow up where appropriate to ensure community members receive adequate support.

Identify issues that require additional technical investigation.

Compliance & Confidentiality

Protect user information and maintain confidentiality.

Follow community guidelines, approved processes, and training materials.

Adhere to applicable Microsoft community standards and Code of Conduct requirements.

Qualifications & Requirements

Strong written communication skills with a professional, respectful, and empathetic tone.

Ability to follow community guidelines, procedures, and training materials closely.

Technical knowledge of Windows and Microsoft products is preferred.

Experience in online support, customer service, community moderation, or technical troubleshooting is an advantage.

Strong attention to accuracy and detail.

Ability to research technical issues and communicate solutions clearly.

Commitment to confidentiality and solution-oriented customer support.

Training & Tools

Training and supporting resources will be provided, including:

Community guidelines and etiquette training.

Access to knowledge base documents, FAQs, and troubleshooting guides.

Hands-on practice with the IXPT Tool for thread management.

Simulated practice threads before handling live cases.

Benefits

Flexible, remote work opportunities.

Access to Microsoft Learn resources and training.

Opportunity to grow technical expertise and reputation in the community.

Monthly income is based on contributions.
